name: PDT.rQ_pow_four
statement: theorem rQ_pow_four : (AdjoinRoot.root fQ) ^ 4 = AdjoinRoot.root fQ + 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Polynomial.aeval (AdjoinRoot.root fQ)) fQ = 0 := by
    rw [AdjoinRoot.aeval_eq, AdjoinRoot.mk_self]
  have h2 : (Polynomial.aeval (AdjoinRoot.root fQ)) (X ^ 4 - X - 1 : ℚ[X]) = 0 := h
  simp only [map_sub, map_pow, map_one, Polynomial.aeval_X] at h2
  linear_combination h2

name: PDT.traceQ_eq
statement:
theorem traceQ_eq (x : AdjoinRoot fQ) :
    Algebra.trace ℚ (AdjoinRoot fQ) x
      = bQ.repr (x * bQ 0) 0 + bQ.repr (x * bQ 1) 1
        + bQ.repr (x * bQ 2) 2 + bQ.repr (x * bQ 3) 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.trace_eq_matrix_trace bQ x]
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag_apply, Algebra.leftMulMatrix_eq_repr_mul,
    Fin.sum_univ_four]

name: PDT.tQ1
statement: theorem tQ1 : Algebra.trace ℚ (AdjoinRoot fQ) (AdjoinRoot.root fQ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [traceQ_eq]
  have e0 : AdjoinRoot.root fQ * bQ 0 = bQ 1 := by rw [bQ0, bQ1]; ring
  have e1 : AdjoinRoot.root fQ * bQ 1 = bQ 2 := by rw [bQ1, bQ2]; ring
  have e2 : AdjoinRoot.root fQ * bQ 2 = bQ 3 := by rw [bQ2, bQ3]; ring
  have e3 : AdjoinRoot.root fQ * bQ 3 = bQ 0 + bQ 1 := by rw [← powQ4, bQ3]; ring
  rw [e0, e1, e2, e3]
  simp

name: PDT.tQ2
statement: theorem tQ2 : Algebra.trace ℚ (AdjoinRoot fQ) (AdjoinRoot.root fQ ^ 2) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [traceQ_eq]
  have e0 : AdjoinRoot.root fQ ^ 2 * bQ 0 = bQ 2 := by rw [bQ0, bQ2]; ring
  have e1 : AdjoinRoot.root fQ ^ 2 * bQ 1 = bQ 3 := by rw [bQ1, bQ3]; ring
  have e2 : AdjoinRoot.root fQ ^ 2 * bQ 2 = bQ 0 + bQ 1 := by rw [← powQ4, bQ2]; ring
  have e3 : AdjoinRoot.root fQ ^ 2 * bQ 3 = bQ 1 + bQ 2 := by rw [← powQ5, bQ3]; ring
  rw [e0, e1, e2, e3]
  simp

name: PDT.tQ3
statement: theorem tQ3 : Algebra.trace ℚ (AdjoinRoot fQ) (AdjoinRoot.root fQ ^ 3) = 3

  have e1 : AdjoinRoot.root fQ ^ 3 * bQ 1 = bQ 0 + bQ 1 := by rw [← powQ4, bQ1]; ring
  have e2 : AdjoinRoot.root fQ ^ 3 * bQ 2 = bQ 1 + bQ 2 := by rw [← powQ5, bQ2]; ring
  have e3 : AdjoinRoot.root fQ ^ 3 * bQ 3 = bQ 2 + bQ 3 := by rw [← powQ6, bQ3]; ring
  rw [e0, e1, e2, e3]
  simp
  norm_num

name: PDT.trace_rootQ_pow
statement:
theorem trace_rootQ_pow (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ 6) :
    Algebra.trace ℚ (AdjoinRoot fQ) (AdjoinRoot.root fQ ^ k)
      = ![4, 0, 0, 3, 4, 0, 3] (⟨k, by omega⟩ : Fin 7)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ i : Fin 7, Algebra.trace ℚ (AdjoinRoot fQ) (AdjoinRoot.root fQ ^ (i : ℕ))
      = ![4, 0, 0, 3, 4, 0, 3] i := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [tQ0, tQ1, tQ2, tQ3, tQ4, tQ5, tQ6]
  exact h ⟨k, by omega⟩

name: PDT.traceMatrix_Q
statement:
theorem traceMatrix_Q (i j : Fin pbQ.dim) :
    Algebra.traceMatrix ℚ (⇑pbQ.basis) i j = M (Fin.cast pbQ_dim i) (Fin.cast pbQ_dim j)
proof:
:= by
  have h : Algebra.traceMatrix ℚ (⇑bQ) (finCongr pbQ_dim i) (finCongr pbQ_dim j)
      = Algebra.traceMatrix ℚ (⇑pbQ.basis) i j := by
    show Algebra.traceMatrix ℚ (⇑(pbQ.basis.reindex (finCongr pbQ_dim)))
        (finCongr pbQ_dim i) (finCongr pbQ_dim j) = _
    rw [Algebra.traceMatrix_reindex]
    simp
  rw [← h, traceMatrix_bQ]
  rfl

name: PDT.quartic_conj_norm_gt_one
statement:
theorem quartic_conj_norm_gt_one (w : ℂ) (hw : w ^ 4 = w + 1) (him : w.im ≠ 0) :
    1 < ‖w‖
proof:
:= by
  have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply him; rw [h]; simp
  have hc : (starRingEnd ℂ) w ^ 4 = (starRingEnd ℂ) w + 1 := by
    have h := congrArg (starRingEnd ℂ) hw
    simpa [map_add, map_pow, map_one] using h
  set σ : ℝ := 2 * w.re with hσ
  set s : ℝ := normSq w with hs
  have hspos : 0 < s := by rw [hs]; exact normSq_pos.mpr hw0
  have hsum : w + (starRingEnd ℂ) w = (σ : ℂ) := by rw [add_conj, hσ]
  have hprod : w * (starRingEnd ℂ) w = (s : ℂ) := by rw [mul_conj, hs]
  have hquad : w ^ 2 = (σ : ℂ) * w - (s : ℂ) := by rw [← hsum, ← hprod]; ring
  have hred : w ^ 4 = ((σ:ℂ)^3 - 2*(s:ℂ)*(σ:ℂ)) * w + ((s:ℂ)^2 - (σ:ℂ)^2*(s:ℂ)) := by
    calc w ^ 4 = (w ^ 2) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = ((σ:ℂ) * w - (s:ℂ)) ^ 2 := by rw [hquad]
      _ = (σ:ℂ)^2 * w^2 - 2*(σ:ℂ)*(s:ℂ)*w + (s:ℂ)^2 := by ring
      _ = (σ:ℂ)^2 * ((σ:ℂ) * w - (s:ℂ)) - 2*(σ:ℂ)*(s:ℂ)*w + (s:ℂ)^2 := by rw [hquad]
      _ = ((σ:ℂ)^3 - 2*(s:ℂ)*(σ:ℂ)) * w + ((s:ℂ)^2 - (σ:ℂ)^2*(s:ℂ)) := by ring
  have hAB : ((σ:ℂ)^3 - 2*(s:ℂ)*(σ:ℂ) - 1) * w + ((s:ℂ)^2 - (σ:ℂ)^2*(s:ℂ) - 1) = 0 := by
    linear_combination hw - hred
  have hABc : ((σ:ℂ)^3 - 2*(s:ℂ)*(σ:ℂ) - 1) * (starRingEnd ℂ) w
      + ((s:ℂ)^2 - (σ:ℂ)^2*(s:ℂ) - 1) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (starRingEnd ℂ) hAB
    simpa [map_add, map_mul, map_sub, map_pow, map_one, map_ofNat, Complex.conj_ofReal] using h
  have hne : w - (starRingEnd ℂ) w ≠ 0 := by
    rw [sub_ne_zero]; intro h; exact him (Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp h.symm)
  have hA : (σ:ℂ)^3 - 2*(s:ℂ)*(σ:ℂ) - 1 = 0 := by
    have hfac : ((σ:ℂ)^3 - 2*(s:ℂ)*(σ:ℂ) - 1) * (w - (starRingEnd ℂ) w) = 0 := by
      linear_combination hAB - hABc
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfac with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd h hne
  have hB : (s:ℂ)^2 - (σ:ℂ)^2*(s:ℂ) - 1 = 0 := by linear_combination hAB - w * hA
  have hEqA : σ^3 - 2*s*σ - 1 = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hA
  have hEqB : s^2 - σ^2*s - 1 = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hB
  have hσne : σ ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h] at hEqA; norm_num at hEqA
  have hσ2 : 0 < σ^2 := by positivity
  have hs2 : 1 < s^2 := by nlinarith [mul_pos hσ2 hspos, hEqB]
  have hs1 : 1 < s := by nlinarith [hs2, hspos]
  have hnorm : ‖w‖ ^ 2 = s := by rw [hs]; exact (Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq w).symm
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg w, hs1, hnorm, sq_nonneg (‖w‖ - 1)]

name: PDT.cubic_conj_norm_lt_one
statement:
theorem cubic_conj_norm_lt_one (z : ℂ) (hz : z ^ 3 = z + 1) (him : z.im ≠ 0) :
    ‖z‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply him; rw [h]; simp
  have hc : (starRingEnd ℂ) z ^ 3 = (starRingEnd ℂ) z + 1 := by
    have h := congrArg (starRingEnd ℂ) hz
    simpa [map_add, map_pow, map_one] using h
  set σ : ℝ := 2 * z.re with hσ
  set s : ℝ := normSq z with hs
  have hspos : 0 < s := by rw [hs]; exact normSq_pos.mpr hz0
  have hsum : z + (starRingEnd ℂ) z = (σ : ℂ) := by rw [add_conj, hσ]
  have hprod : z * (starRingEnd ℂ) z = (s : ℂ) := by rw [mul_conj, hs]
  have hquad : z ^ 2 = (σ : ℂ) * z - (s : ℂ) := by rw [← hsum, ← hprod]; ring
  have hred : z ^ 3 = ((σ:ℂ)^2 - (s:ℂ)) * z - (σ:ℂ)*(s:ℂ) := by
    calc z ^ 3 = z * z ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = z * ((σ:ℂ) * z - (s:ℂ)) := by rw [hquad]
      _ = (σ:ℂ) * z^2 - (s:ℂ)*z := by ring
      _ = (σ:ℂ) * ((σ:ℂ) * z - (s:ℂ)) - (s:ℂ)*z := by rw [hquad]
      _ = ((σ:ℂ)^2 - (s:ℂ)) * z - (σ:ℂ)*(s:ℂ) := by ring
  have hAB : ((σ:ℂ)^2 - (s:ℂ) - 1) * z + (-(σ:ℂ)*(s:ℂ) - 1) = 0 := by
    linear_combination hz - hred
  have hABc : ((σ:ℂ)^2 - (s:ℂ) - 1) * (starRingEnd ℂ) z + (-(σ:ℂ)*(s:ℂ) - 1) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (starRingEnd ℂ) hAB
    simpa [map_add, map_mul, map_sub, map_neg, map_pow, map_one, map_ofNat,
      Complex.conj_ofReal] using h
  have hne : z - (starRingEnd ℂ) z ≠ 0 := by
    rw [sub_ne_zero]; intro h; exact him (Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp h.symm)
  have hA : (σ:ℂ)^2 - (s:ℂ) - 1 = 0 := by
    have hfac : ((σ:ℂ)^2 - (s:ℂ) - 1) * (z - (starRingEnd ℂ) z) = 0 := by
      linear_combination hAB - hABc
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfac with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd h hne
  have hB : -(σ:ℂ)*(s:ℂ) - 1 = 0 := by linear_combination hAB - z * hA
  have hEqA : σ^2 - s - 1 = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hA
  have hEqB : -σ*s - 1 = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hB
  have hcubic : s^3 + s^2 - 1 = 0 := by linear_combination (-σ*s + 1) * hEqB - s^2 * hEqA
  have hs2lt : s^2 < 1 := by nlinarith [hcubic, pow_pos hspos 3]
  have hs1 : s < 1 := by nlinarith [hs2lt, hspos]
  have hnorm : ‖z‖ ^ 2 = s := by rw [hs]; exact (Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq z).symm
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg z, hs1, hnorm, sq_nonneg (‖z‖ - 1)]

name: PDT.pisot_boundary_dichotomy
statement:
theorem pisot_boundary_dichotomy
    (z : ℂ) (hz : z ^ 3 = z + 1) (hzim : z.im ≠ 0)
    (w : ℂ) (hw : w ^ 4 = w + 1) (hwim : w.im ≠ 0) :
    ‖z‖ < 1 ∧ 1 < ‖w‖
proof:
:=
  ⟨cubic_conj_norm_lt_one z hz hzim, quartic_conj_norm_gt_one w hw hwim⟩

name: PDT.born_eq_trace_comp_conj
statement: theorem born_eq_trace_comp_conj : Gborn = Gtr * Cnj
proof:
:= by
  ext i j; fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [Gborn, Gtr, Cnj, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]

name: PDT.J_born_isometry
statement: theorem J_born_isometry : Jc.transpose * Gborn * Jc = Gborn
proof:
:= by
  ext i j; fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [Jc, Gborn, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.transpose_apply]

name: PDT.J_trace_antiisometry
statement: theorem J_trace_antiisometry : Jc.transpose * Gtr * Jc = -Gtr
proof:
:= by
  ext i j; fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [Jc, Gtr, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.transpose_apply,
      Matrix.neg_apply]

name: PDT.omegaB_eq
statement: theorem omegaB_eq : Jc.transpose * Gborn = omegaB
proof:
:= by

name: PDT.omega_born_skew
statement: theorem omega_born_skew : omegaB.transpose = -omegaB
proof:

  ext i j; fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>

name: PDT.omega_born_nondegenerate
statement: theorem omega_born_nondegenerate : omegaB.det = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [omegaB, Matrix.det_fin_two]

name: PDT.omega_trace_symm
statement: theorem omega_trace_symm : (Jc.transpose * Gtr).transpose = Jc.transpose * Gtr
proof:
:= by
  ext i j; fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [Jc, Gtr, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.transpose_apply]

name: PDT.faultA_symplectic
statement:
theorem faultA_symplectic :
    Gborn = Gtr * Cnj ∧
    Jc.transpose * Gborn * Jc = Gborn ∧
    Jc.transpose * Gtr * Jc = -Gtr ∧
    Jc.transpose * Gborn = omegaB ∧
    omegaB.transpose = -omegaB ∧
    omegaB.det = 1 ∧
    (Jc.transpose * Gtr).transpose = Jc.transpose * Gtr
proof:
:=
  ⟨born_eq_trace_comp_conj, J_born_isometry, J_trace_antiisometry,
   omegaB_eq, omega_born_skew, omega_born_nondegenerate, omega_trace_symm⟩

name: PDT.f4_monic
statement: theorem f4_monic : (f4).Monic
proof:
:= by
  show ((X^4 - X - 1 : ℚ[X])).Monic
  have : (X^4 - X - 1 : ℚ[X]) = X^4 + (- X - 1) := by ring
  rw [this]; apply monic_X_pow_add; compute_degree!

name: PDT.f4_ne
statement: theorem f4_ne : f4 ≠ 0
proof: := f4_monic.ne_zero

name: PDT.f4_deg
statement: theorem f4_deg : f4.natDegree = 4
proof:
:= by
  show (X^4 - X - 1 : ℚ[X]).natDegree = 4; compute_degree!

name: PDT.pb4_dim
statement: theorem pb4_dim : pb4.dim = 4
proof: := f4_deg

name: PDT.r4_pow4
statement: theorem r4_pow4 : r4^4 = r4 + 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : aeval r4 f4 = 0 := by rw [aeval_eq, mk_self]
  show (root f4)^4 = root f4 + 1
  simp only [f4, map_sub, map_pow, map_one, aeval_X] at h
  linear_combination h

name: PDT.r4_pow5
statement: theorem r4_pow5 : r4^5 = r4^2 + r4
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (r4) * r4_pow4

name: PDT.r4_pow6
statement: theorem r4_pow6 : r4^6 = r4^3 + r4^2
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (r4^2) * r4_pow4

name: PDT.r4_pow7
statement: theorem r4_pow7 : r4^7 = r4^3 + r4 + 1
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (r4^3 + 1) * r4_pow4

name: PDT.r4_pow8
statement: theorem r4_pow8 : r4^8 = r4^2 + 2 * r4 + 1
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (r4^4 + r4 + 1) * r4_pow4

name: PDT.r4_pow9
statement: theorem r4_pow9 : r4^9 = r4^3 + 2 * r4^2 + r4
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (r4^5 + r4^2 + r4) * r4_pow4

name: PDT.basis_val
statement: theorem basis_val (i : Fin 4) : pb4.basis (ι i) = r4 ^ (i:ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [PowerBasis.coe_basis]; rfl

name: PDT.basis_val0
statement: theorem basis_val0 : pb4.basis (ι 0) = r4^(0:ℕ)
proof: := by rw [basis_val]; norm_num

name: PDT.basis_val1
statement: theorem basis_val1 : pb4.basis (ι 1) = r4^(1:ℕ)
proof: := by rw [basis_val]; norm_num

name: PDT.basis_val2
statement: theorem basis_val2 : pb4.basis (ι 2) = r4^(2:ℕ)
proof: := by rw [basis_val]; norm_num

name: PDT.basis_val3
statement: theorem basis_val3 : pb4.basis (ι 3) = r4^(3:ℕ)
proof: := by rw [basis_val]; norm_num

name: PDT.repr_comb
statement:
theorem repr_comb (a b c d : ℚ) (j : Fin 4) :
    pb4.basis.repr (a • r4^(0:ℕ) + b • r4^(1:ℕ) + c • r4^(2:ℕ) + d • r4^(3:ℕ)) (ι j)
      = ![a,b,c,d] j
proof:
:= by
  rw [← basis_val0, ← basis_val1, ← basis_val2, ← basis_val3]
  simp only [map_add, map_smul, Finsupp.coe_add, Finsupp.coe_smul, Pi.add_apply,
    Pi.smul_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  fin_cases j <;> simp [ι, Fin.ext_iff]

name: PDT.repr0
statement: theorem repr0 (j : Fin 4) : pb4.basis.repr (r4^(0:ℕ)) (ι j) = ![1,0,0,0] j
proof:
:= by
  have := repr_comb 1 0 0 0 j; simpa using this

name: PDT.repr1
statement: theorem repr1 (j : Fin 4) : pb4.basis.repr (r4^(1:ℕ)) (ι j) = ![0,1,0,0] j
proof:
:= by
  have := repr_comb 0 1 0 0 j; simpa using this

name: PDT.repr2
statement: theorem repr2 (j : Fin 4) : pb4.basis.repr (r4^(2:ℕ)) (ι j) = ![0,0,1,0] j
proof:
:= by
  have := repr_comb 0 0 1 0 j; simpa using this

name: PDT.repr3
statement: theorem repr3 (j : Fin 4) : pb4.basis.repr (r4^(3:ℕ)) (ι j) = ![0,0,0,1] j
proof:
:= by
  have := repr_comb 0 0 0 1 j; simpa using this

name: PDT.repr4
statement: theorem repr4 (j : Fin 4) : pb4.basis.repr (r4^(4:ℕ)) (ι j) = ![1,1,0,0] j
proof:
:= by
  have h := repr_comb 1 1 0 0 j
  rw [r4_pow4]
  rw [show (r4 + 1 : AdjoinRoot f4)
        = (1:ℚ) • r4^(0:ℕ) + (1:ℚ) • r4^(1:ℕ) + (0:ℚ) • r4^(2:ℕ) + (0:ℚ) • r4^(3:ℕ) by
        simp only [Algebra.smul_def, map_ofNat, map_one, map_zero]; ring]
  exact h

name: PDT.repr5
statement: theorem repr5 (j : Fin 4) : pb4.basis.repr (r4^(5:ℕ)) (ι j) = ![0,1,1,0] j
proof:
:= by
  have h := repr_comb 0 1 1 0 j
  rw [r4_pow5]
  rw [show (r4^2 + r4 : AdjoinRoot f4)
        = (0:ℚ) • r4^(0:ℕ) + (1:ℚ) • r4^(1:ℕ) + (1:ℚ) • r4^(2:ℕ) + (0:ℚ) • r4^(3:ℕ) by
        simp only [Algebra.smul_def, map_ofNat, map_one, map_zero]; ring]
  exact h

name: PDT.repr6
statement: theorem repr6 (j : Fin 4) : pb4.basis.repr (r4^(6:ℕ)) (ι j) = ![0,0,1,1] j
proof:
:= by
  have h := repr_comb 0 0 1 1 j
  rw [r4_pow6]
  rw [show (r4^3 + r4^2 : AdjoinRoot f4)
        = (0:ℚ) • r4^(0:ℕ) + (0:ℚ) • r4^(1:ℕ) + (1:ℚ) • r4^(2:ℕ) + (1:ℚ) • r4^(3:ℕ) by
        simp only [Algebra.smul_def, map_ofNat, map_one, map_zero]; ring]
  exact h

name: PDT.repr7
statement: theorem repr7 (j : Fin 4) : pb4.basis.repr (r4^(7:ℕ)) (ι j) = ![1,1,0,1] j
proof:
:= by
  have h := repr_comb 1 1 0 1 j
  rw [r4_pow7]
  rw [show (r4^3 + r4 + 1 : AdjoinRoot f4)
        = (1:ℚ) • r4^(0:ℕ) + (1:ℚ) • r4^(1:ℕ) + (0:ℚ) • r4^(2:ℕ) + (1:ℚ) • r4^(3:ℕ) by
        simp only [Algebra.smul_def, map_ofNat, map_one, map_zero]; ring]
  exact h

name: PDT.repr8
statement: theorem repr8 (j : Fin 4) : pb4.basis.repr (r4^(8:ℕ)) (ι j) = ![1,2,1,0] j
proof:
:= by
  have h := repr_comb 1 2 1 0 j
  rw [r4_pow8]
  rw [show (r4^2 + 2 * r4 + 1 : AdjoinRoot f4)
        = (1:ℚ) • r4^(0:ℕ) + (2:ℚ) • r4^(1:ℕ) + (1:ℚ) • r4^(2:ℕ) + (0:ℚ) • r4^(3:ℕ) by
        simp only [Algebra.smul_def, map_ofNat, map_one, map_zero]; ring]
  exact h

name: PDT.repr9
statement: theorem repr9 (j : Fin 4) : pb4.basis.repr (r4^(9:ℕ)) (ι j) = ![0,1,2,1] j
proof:
:= by
  have h := repr_comb 0 1 2 1 j
  rw [r4_pow9]
  rw [show (r4^3 + 2 * r4^2 + r4 : AdjoinRoot f4)
        = (0:ℚ) • r4^(0:ℕ) + (1:ℚ) • r4^(1:ℕ) + (2:ℚ) • r4^(2:ℕ) + (1:ℚ) • r4^(3:ℕ) by
        simp only [Algebra.smul_def, map_ofNat, map_one, map_zero]; ring]
  exact h

name: PDT.trace_eq_sum
statement:
theorem trace_eq_sum (k : ℕ) :
    Algebra.trace ℚ (AdjoinRoot f4) (r4^k)
      = ∑ j : Fin 4, pb4.basis.repr (r4^(k + (j:ℕ))) (ι j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.trace_eq_matrix_trace pb4.basis, Matrix.trace]
  simp only [Matrix.diag_apply, Algebra.leftMulMatrix_eq_repr_mul]
  refine Fintype.sum_equiv (finCongr pb4_dim.symm)
        (fun j => pb4.basis.repr (r4^(k + (j:ℕ))) (ι j))
        (fun j => pb4.basis.repr (r4^k * pb4.basis j) j) (fun j => ?_) |>.symm
  have hb : pb4.basis (ι j) = r4^(j:ℕ) := basis_val j
  show pb4.basis.repr (r4^(k + (j:ℕ))) (ι j)
      = pb4.basis.repr (r4^k * pb4.basis (ι j)) (ι j)
  rw [hb, ← pow_add]

name: PDT.trace_r4_pow0
statement: theorem trace_r4_pow0 : Algebra.trace ℚ (AdjoinRoot f4) (r4^0) = 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_eq_sum]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_four]
  rw [show (0:ℕ)+((0:Fin 4):ℕ) = 0 by rfl, show (0:ℕ)+((1:Fin 4):ℕ) = 1 by rfl,
      show (0:ℕ)+((2:Fin 4):ℕ) = 2 by rfl, show (0:ℕ)+((3:Fin 4):ℕ) = 3 by rfl,
      repr0, repr1, repr2, repr3]
  norm_num [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail, Matrix.cons_val]

name: PDT.trace_r4_pow1
statement: theorem trace_r4_pow1 : Algebra.trace ℚ (AdjoinRoot f4) (r4^1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_eq_sum]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_four]
  rw [show (1:ℕ)+((0:Fin 4):ℕ) = 1 by rfl, show (1:ℕ)+((1:Fin 4):ℕ) = 2 by rfl,
      show (1:ℕ)+((2:Fin 4):ℕ) = 3 by rfl, show (1:ℕ)+((3:Fin 4):ℕ) = 4 by rfl,
      repr1, repr2, repr3, repr4]
  norm_num [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail, Matrix.cons_val]

name: PDT.trace_r4_pow2
statement: theorem trace_r4_pow2 : Algebra.trace ℚ (AdjoinRoot f4) (r4^2) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_eq_sum]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_four]
  rw [show (2:ℕ)+((0:Fin 4):ℕ) = 2 by rfl, show (2:ℕ)+((1:Fin 4):ℕ) = 3 by rfl,
      show (2:ℕ)+((2:Fin 4):ℕ) = 4 by rfl, show (2:ℕ)+((3:Fin 4):ℕ) = 5 by rfl,
      repr2, repr3, repr4, repr5]
  norm_num [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail, Matrix.cons_val]

name: PDT.trace_r4_pow3
statement: theorem trace_r4_pow3 : Algebra.trace ℚ (AdjoinRoot f4) (r4^3) = 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_eq_sum]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_four]
  rw [show (3:ℕ)+((0:Fin 4):ℕ) = 3 by rfl, show (3:ℕ)+((1:Fin 4):ℕ) = 4 by rfl,
      show (3:ℕ)+((2:Fin 4):ℕ) = 5 by rfl, show (3:ℕ)+((3:Fin 4):ℕ) = 6 by rfl,
      repr3, repr4, repr5, repr6]
  norm_num [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail, Matrix.cons_val]

name: PDT.trace_r4_pow4
statement: theorem trace_r4_pow4 : Algebra.trace ℚ (AdjoinRoot f4) (r4^4) = 4
proof:
:= by
  have : Algebra.trace ℚ (AdjoinRoot f4) (r4^4)
      = Algebra.trace ℚ (AdjoinRoot f4) (r4 + 1) := by rw [r4_pow4]
  rw [this, map_add]
  have h1 : Algebra.trace ℚ (AdjoinRoot f4) (r4) = 0 := by
    have := trace_r4_pow1; simpa using this
  have h0 : Algebra.trace ℚ (AdjoinRoot f4) (1 : AdjoinRoot f4) = 4 := by
    have := trace_r4_pow0; simpa using this
  rw [h1, h0]; norm_num

name: PDT.trace_r4_pow5
statement: theorem trace_r4_pow5 : Algebra.trace ℚ (AdjoinRoot f4) (r4^5) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_eq_sum, Fin.sum_univ_four]
  rw [show (5:ℕ)+((0:Fin 4):ℕ) = 5 by rfl, show (5:ℕ)+((1:Fin 4):ℕ) = 6 by rfl,
      show (5:ℕ)+((2:Fin 4):ℕ) = 7 by rfl, show (5:ℕ)+((3:Fin 4):ℕ) = 8 by rfl]
  rw [repr5, repr6, repr7, repr8]
  norm_num [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
    Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail, Matrix.cons_val]

name: PDT.trace_r4_pow6
statement: theorem trace_r4_pow6 : Algebra.trace ℚ (AdjoinRoot f4) (r4^6) = 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_eq_sum, Fin.sum_univ_four]
  rw [show (6:ℕ)+((0:Fin 4):ℕ) = 6 by rfl, show (6:ℕ)+((1:Fin 4):ℕ) = 7 by rfl,
      show (6:ℕ)+((2:Fin 4):ℕ) = 8 by rfl, show (6:ℕ)+((3:Fin 4):ℕ) = 9 by rfl]
  rw [repr6, repr7, repr8, repr9]
  norm_num [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
    Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail, Matrix.cons_val]

name: PDT.traceForm_basis
statement:
theorem traceForm_basis (i j : Fin 4) :
    Algebra.traceForm ℚ (AdjoinRoot f4) (pb4.basis (ι i)) (pb4.basis (ι j))
      = Algebra.trace ℚ (AdjoinRoot f4) (r4^((i:ℕ) + (j:ℕ)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.traceForm_apply, basis_val i, basis_val j, ← pow_add]

name: PDT.traceForm_eq_M4
statement:
theorem traceForm_eq_M4 (i j : Fin 4) :
    Algebra.traceForm ℚ (AdjoinRoot f4) (pb4.basis (ι i)) (pb4.basis (ι j))
      = M4 i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [traceForm_basis]
  have e0 := trace_r4_pow0; have e1 := trace_r4_pow1; have e2 := trace_r4_pow2
  have e3 := trace_r4_pow3; have e4 := trace_r4_pow4; have e5 := trace_r4_pow5
  have e6 := trace_r4_pow6
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp only [Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_one, Fin.val_two, Fin.isValue,
      show ((3:Fin 4):ℕ) = 3 from rfl, Nat.reduceAdd, e0, e1, e2, e3, e4, e5, e6] <;>
    rfl

name: PDT.traceMatrix_eq_M4
statement:
theorem traceMatrix_eq_M4 (i j : Fin 4) :
    Algebra.traceMatrix ℚ (⇑pb4.basis) (ι i) (ι j) = M4 i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.traceMatrix_apply]
  exact traceForm_eq_M4 i j

name: PDT.Mρ_symm
statement: theorem Mρ_symm : Mρ.IsSymm
proof:
:= by
  ext i j; fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [Mρ, Matrix.transpose_apply]

name: PDT.detMρ
statement: theorem detMρ : Mρ.det = -23
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.det_fin_three, Mρ]; norm_num

name: PDT.detMρ_neg
statement: theorem detMρ_neg : Mρ.det < 0
proof: := by rw [detMρ]; norm_num

name: PDT.congruenceρ
statement: theorem congruenceρ : Pρ.transpose * Mρ * Pρ = Dρ
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [Pρ, Mρ, Dρ, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.transpose_apply] <;> norm_num

name: PDT.detPρ
statement: theorem detPρ : Pρ.det = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.det_fin_three, Pρ]

name: PDT.Pρ_isUnit
statement: theorem Pρ_isUnit : IsUnit Pρ.det
proof: := by rw [detPρ]; exact isUnit_one

name: PDT.Dρ_isDiag
statement: theorem Dρ_isDiag : Dρ.IsDiag
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij; fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp_all [Dρ]

name: PDT.Dρ00_pos
statement: theorem Dρ00_pos : (0:ℚ) < Dρ 0 0
proof: := by show (0:ℚ) < 3; norm_num

name: PDT.Dρ11_pos
statement: theorem Dρ11_pos : (0:ℚ) < Dρ 1 1
proof: := by show (0:ℚ) < 2; norm_num

name: PDT.Dρ22_neg
statement: theorem Dρ22_neg : Dρ 2 2 < (0:ℚ)
proof: := by show (-23/6:ℚ) < 0; norm_num

name: PDT.signature_2_1
statement:
theorem signature_2_1 :
    Mρ.IsSymm ∧ Pρ.transpose * Mρ * Pρ = Dρ ∧ IsUnit Pρ.det ∧ Dρ.IsDiag ∧
    (0 < Dρ 0 0 ∧ 0 < Dρ 1 1) ∧ Dρ 2 2 < 0 ∧ Mρ.det = -23
proof:
:=
  ⟨Mρ_symm, congruenceρ, Pρ_isUnit, Dρ_isDiag, ⟨Dρ00_pos, Dρ11_pos⟩, Dρ22_neg, detMρ⟩

name: PDT.embed_tick
statement:
lemma embed_tick {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (t : K) (ht : t ^ 3 = t + 1)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) : embed t (tick p) = t * embed t p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, c⟩ := p
  simp only [embed, tick]
  push_cast
  linear_combination (-(c : K)) * ht

name: PDT.embed_tick_iter
statement:
lemma embed_tick_iter {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (t : K) (ht : t ^ 3 = t + 1)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) (n : ℕ) : embed t (tick^[n] p) = t ^ n * embed t p
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', embed_tick t ht, ih, pow_succ]
      ring

name: PDT.embed_sub
statement:
lemma embed_sub {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (t : K) (p q : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) :
    embed t (p - q) = embed t p - embed t q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [embed, Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub]
  push_cast
  ring

name: PDT.conj_embed
statement:
lemma conj_embed (z : ℂ) (p : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) :
    (starRingEnd ℂ) (embed z p) = embed ((starRingEnd ℂ) z) p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [embed, map_add, map_mul, map_pow, map_intCast]

name: PDT.z_ne_ofReal
statement: private lemma z_ne_ofReal (him : z.im ≠ 0) : z ≠ (r : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply him
  rw [h, Complex.ofReal_im]

name: PDT.quad_of_nonreal_root
statement:
lemma quad_of_nonreal_root (hr : r ^ 3 = r + 1) (hz : z ^ 3 = z + 1)
    (him : z.im ≠ 0) : z ^ 2 + (r : ℂ) * z + ((r : ℂ) ^ 2 - 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hrC : (r : ℂ) ^ 3 = (r : ℂ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have hfac : (z - (r : ℂ)) * (z ^ 2 + (r : ℂ) * z + ((r : ℂ) ^ 2 - 1)) = 0 := by
    linear_combination hz - hrC
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfac with h | h
  · exact absurd (sub_eq_zero.mp h) (z_ne_ofReal him)
  · exact h

name: PDT.add_conj_root
statement:
lemma add_conj_root (hr : r ^ 3 = r + 1) (hz : z ^ 3 = z + 1)
    (him : z.im ≠ 0) : z + (starRingEnd ℂ) z = -(r : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have key := quad_of_nonreal_root hr hz him
  have key2 : ((starRingEnd ℂ) z) ^ 2 + (r : ℂ) * ((starRingEnd ℂ) z)
      + ((r : ℂ) ^ 2 - 1) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (starRingEnd ℂ) key
    simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, map_one, map_zero,
      Complex.conj_ofReal] at h
    exact h
  have hne : z - (starRingEnd ℂ) z ≠ 0 := by
    rw [sub_ne_zero]
    intro h
    exact him (Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp h.symm)
  have hfac : (z - (starRingEnd ℂ) z) * (z + (starRingEnd ℂ) z + (r : ℂ)) = 0 := by
    linear_combination key - key2
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfac with h | h
  · exact absurd h hne
  · linear_combination h

name: PDT.mul_conj_root
statement:
lemma mul_conj_root (hr : r ^ 3 = r + 1) (hz : z ^ 3 = z + 1)
    (him : z.im ≠ 0) : z * (starRingEnd ℂ) z = (r : ℂ) ^ 2 - 1
proof:
:= by
  have key := quad_of_nonreal_root hr hz him
  have hsum := add_conj_root hr hz him
  linear_combination z * hsum - key

name: PDT.tick_contraction
statement:
theorem tick_contraction (hr : r ^ 3 = r + 1) (hz : z ^ 3 = z + 1)
    (him : z.im ≠ 0) : r * ‖z‖ ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := mul_conj_root hr hz him
  rw [Complex.mul_conj] at h
  have h2 : Complex.normSq z = r ^ 2 - 1 := by exact_mod_cast h
  rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, h2]
  linear_combination hr

name: PDT.one_lt_root
statement: theorem one_lt_root (hr : r ^ 3 = r + 1) : 1 < r
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hle
  rw [not_lt] at hle
  have h1 : 0 ≤ (1 - r) * (r + 1) ^ 2 := mul_nonneg (by linarith) (sq_nonneg _)
  have h2 : (1 - r) * (r + 1) ^ 2 = -r ^ 2 := by linear_combination -hr
  have h3 : r ^ 2 = 0 := le_antisymm (by linarith) (sq_nonneg r)
  have h4 : r = 0 := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp h3
  rw [h4] at hr
  norm_num at hr

name: PDT.norm_z_lt_one
statement:
theorem norm_z_lt_one (hr : r ^ 3 = r + 1) (hz : z ^ 3 = z + 1)
    (him : z.im ≠ 0) : ‖z‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := tick_contraction hr hz him
  have h2 := one_lt_root hr
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg z, sq_nonneg (‖z‖ - 1), sq_nonneg (‖z‖ + 1)]

name: PDT.norm_z_eq_rpow
statement:
theorem norm_z_eq_rpow (hr : r ^ 3 = r + 1) (hz : z ^ 3 = z + 1)
    (him : z.im ≠ 0) : ‖z‖ = r ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := tick_contraction hr hz him
  have hrpos : (0 : ℝ) < r := lt_trans one_pos (one_lt_root hr)
  have hrne : r ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hrpos
  have hz2 : ‖z‖ ^ 2 = r⁻¹ := by
    field_simp
    linear_combination h1
  calc ‖z‖ = Real.sqrt (‖z‖ ^ 2) := (Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg z)).symm
    _ = Real.sqrt r⁻¹ := by rw [hz2]
    _ = (r⁻¹) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) := Real.sqrt_eq_rpow _
    _ = (r ^ ((-1 : ℝ))) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) := by rw [Real.rpow_neg_one]
    _ = r ^ ((-1 : ℝ) * (1 / 2)) := (Real.rpow_mul hrpos.le _ _).symm
    _ = r ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ) := by norm_num

name: PDT.normForm_factor
statement:
lemma normForm_factor (hr : r ^ 3 = r + 1) (hz : z ^ 3 = z + 1)
    (him : z.im ≠ 0) (p : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) :
    ((embed r p : ℝ) : ℂ) * embed z p * (starRingEnd ℂ) (embed z p)
      = ((normForm p : ℤ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, c⟩ := p
  have hrC : (r : ℂ) ^ 3 = (r : ℂ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have key := quad_of_nonreal_root hr hz him
  have hconj : (starRingEnd ℂ) z = -(r : ℂ) - z := by
    linear_combination add_conj_root hr hz him
  rw [conj_embed]
  simp only [embed, normForm]
  rw [hconj]
  push_cast
  linear_combination
    (2 * (a : ℂ) ^ 2 * c - a * (b : ℂ) ^ 2 + 3 * (a : ℂ) * b * c * r
      + (a : ℂ) * c ^ 2 * (r : ℂ) ^ 2 + (a : ℂ) * c ^ 2 * r * z
      + (a : ℂ) * c ^ 2 * z ^ 2 + (a : ℂ) * c ^ 2 - (b : ℂ) ^ 3 * r
      + (b : ℂ) * c ^ 2 * (r : ℂ) ^ 2 * z + (b : ℂ) * c ^ 2 * r * z ^ 2
      + (b : ℂ) * c ^ 2 * r - (c : ℂ) ^ 3 * (r : ℂ) ^ 4
      + (c : ℂ) ^ 3 * (r : ℂ) ^ 3 * z + (c : ℂ) ^ 3 * (r : ℂ) ^ 2 * z ^ 2
      + (c : ℂ) ^ 3 * (r : ℂ) ^ 2) * key
    + (-3 * (a : ℂ) * b * c + (b : ℂ) ^ 3 - (b : ℂ) * c ^ 2
      + (c : ℂ) ^ 3 * (r : ℂ) ^ 3 - (c : ℂ) ^ 3 * r + (c : ℂ) ^ 3) * hrC

name: PDT.normForm_eq_mul_normSq
statement:
lemma normForm_eq_mul_normSq (hr : r ^ 3 = r + 1) (hz : z ^ 3 = z + 1)
    (him : z.im ≠ 0) (p : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) :
    (normForm p : ℝ) = embed r p * Complex.normSq (embed z p)
proof:
:= by
  have h := normForm_factor hr hz him p
  rw [mul_assoc, Complex.mul_conj] at h
  exact_mod_cast h.symm

name: PDT.embed_ne_zero
statement:
lemma embed_ne_zero {K : Type*} [Field K] [Algebra ℚ K] {t : K}
    (ht : t ^ 3 = t + 1) {p : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ} (hp : p ≠ 0) : embed t p ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, c⟩ := p
  have htroot : aeval t (X ^ 3 - X - 1 : ℚ[X]) = 0 := by
    simp only [map_sub, map_pow, aeval_X, map_one]
    linear_combination ht
  have hmonic : (X ^ 3 - X - 1 : ℚ[X]).Monic := by monicity!
  have hmin : minpoly ℚ t = X ^ 3 - X - 1 :=
    (minpoly.eq_of_irreducible_of_monic cubicQ_irreducible htroot hmonic).symm
  intro h0
  have hqz : aeval t (C (a : ℚ) + C (b : ℚ) * X + C (c : ℚ) * X ^ 2) = 0 := by
    simp only [map_add, map_mul, map_pow, aeval_X, map_intCast]
    simpa [embed] using h0
  have hqne : (C (a : ℚ) + C (b : ℚ) * X + C (c : ℚ) * X ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hq0
    apply hp
    have ha' : a = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun f => Polynomial.coeff f 0) hq0
      simp only [coeff_add, coeff_C_mul, coeff_C, coeff_X, coeff_X_pow, coeff_zero] at h
      norm_num at h
      exact h
    have hb' : b = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun f => Polynomial.coeff f 1) hq0
      simp only [coeff_add, coeff_C_mul, coeff_C, coeff_X, coeff_X_pow, coeff_zero] at h
      norm_num at h
      exact h
    have hc' : c = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun f => Polynomial.coeff f 2) hq0
      simp only [coeff_add, coeff_C_mul, coeff_C, coeff_X, coeff_X_pow, coeff_zero] at h
      norm_num at h
      exact h
    subst ha' hb' hc'
    rfl
  have hle := minpoly.degree_le_of_ne_zero ℚ t hqne hqz
  have h1 : (minpoly ℚ t).natDegree ≤
      (C (a : ℚ) + C (b : ℚ) * X + C (c : ℚ) * X ^ 2).natDegree :=
    Polynomial.natDegree_le_natDegree hle
  have h2 : (minpoly ℚ t).natDegree = 3 := by
    rw [hmin]
    compute_degree!
  have h3 : (C (a : ℚ) + C (b : ℚ) * X + C (c : ℚ) * X ^ 2).natDegree ≤ 2 := by
    compute_degree!
  omega

name: PDT.meyer_separation
statement:
theorem meyer_separation (hr : r ^ 3 = r + 1) (hz : z ^ 3 = z + 1)
    (him : z.im ≠ 0) (p : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    1 ≤ |embed r p| * ‖embed z p‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hfac := normForm_eq_mul_normSq hr hz him p
  have h1 : embed r p ≠ 0 := embed_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast hr) hp
  have h2 : embed z p ≠ 0 := embed_ne_zero hz hp
  have hNne : normForm p ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply mul_ne_zero h1 (fun hh => h2 (Complex.normSq_eq_zero.mp hh))
    rw [← hfac, h, Int.cast_zero]
  have hN1 : (1 : ℤ) ≤ |normForm p| := Int.one_le_abs hNne
  calc (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(normForm p : ℝ)| := by exact_mod_cast hN1
    _ = |embed r p * Complex.normSq (embed z p)| := by rw [hfac]
    _ = |embed r p| * Complex.normSq (embed z p) := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Complex.normSq_nonneg _)]
    _ = |embed r p| * ‖embed z p‖ ^ 2 := by rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]

name: PDT.meyer_separation_rpow
statement:
theorem meyer_separation_rpow (hr : r ^ 3 = r + 1) (hz : z ^ 3 = z + 1)
    (him : z.im ≠ 0) (p : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    |embed r p| ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ) ≤ ‖embed z p‖
proof:
:= by
  have hsep := meyer_separation hr hz him p hp
  have hx1 : embed r p ≠ 0 := embed_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast hr) hp
  have habs : 0 < |embed r p| := abs_pos.mpr hx1
  have hsq : (|embed r p| ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ)) ^ 2 = |embed r p|⁻¹ := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_two, ← Real.rpow_mul habs.le]
    norm_num [Real.rpow_neg_one]
  have hinv : |embed r p| * |embed r p|⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ habs.ne'
  have hle2 : |embed r p|⁻¹ ≤ ‖embed z p‖ ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hsep, habs]
  have ht : 0 < |embed r p| ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos habs _
  nlinarith [hsq, hle2, ht, norm_nonneg (embed z p)]

name: PDT.lattice_tick_invariant
statement:
theorem lattice_tick_invariant (hz : z ^ 3 = z + 1) :
    (fun x => z * x) '' lattice z = lattice z
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, ⟨p, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨tick p, embed_tick z hz p⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨a, b, c⟩ := p
    refine ⟨embed z (b - a, c, a), ⟨(b - a, c, a), rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    show z * embed z (b - a, c, a) = embed z (a, b, c)
    rw [← embed_tick z hz]
    have h : b - a + a = b := by omega
    show embed z (a, b - a + a, c) = embed z (a, b, c)
    rw [h]

name: PDT.windowed_separation
statement:
theorem windowed_separation (hr : r ^ 3 = r + 1) (hz : z ^ 3 = z + 1)
    (him : z.im ≠ 0) {p q : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ} (hpq : p ≠ q) {H : ℝ}
    (hH : |embed r p - embed r q| ≤ H) :
    H ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ) ≤ ‖embed z p - embed z q‖
proof:
:= by
  have hne : p - q ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hpq
  have h1 := meyer_separation_rpow hr hz him (p - q) hne
  rw [embed_sub, embed_sub] at h1
  have habs : 0 < |embed r p - embed r q| := by
    rw [abs_pos, ← embed_sub]
    exact embed_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast hr) hne
  exact le_trans (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos habs hH (by norm_num)) h1

name: PDT.certification_soundness
statement:
theorem certification_soundness (hr : r ^ 3 = r + 1) (hz : z ^ 3 = z + 1)
    (him : z.im ≠ 0) (w : ℂ) (ℓ : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H)
    (hw : ‖w - embed z ℓ‖ < H ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ) / 2)
    (n : ℕ) (ℓ' : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) (hne : ℓ' ≠ tick^[n] ℓ)
    (hwin : |embed r ℓ' - r ^ n * embed r ℓ| ≤ H) :
    ‖z ^ n * w - z ^ n * embed z ℓ‖ < ‖z ^ n * w - embed z ℓ'‖
proof:
:= by
  have hdpos : 0 < H ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hH _
  have hzn : ‖z ^ n‖ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [norm_pow]
    exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg z) (norm_z_lt_one hr hz him).le
  have hcommit : ‖z ^ n * w - z ^ n * embed z ℓ‖ < H ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ) / 2 := by
    calc ‖z ^ n * w - z ^ n * embed z ℓ‖ = ‖z ^ n‖ * ‖w - embed z ℓ‖ := by
          rw [← norm_mul, mul_sub]
      _ ≤ 1 * ‖w - embed z ℓ‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hzn (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = ‖w - embed z ℓ‖ := one_mul _
      _ < H ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ) / 2 := hw
  have hsep : H ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ) ≤ ‖embed z ℓ' - z ^ n * embed z ℓ‖ := by
    rw [← embed_tick_iter z hz]
    rw [← embed_tick_iter r hr] at hwin
    exact windowed_separation hr hz him hne hwin
  have htri : ‖embed z ℓ' - z ^ n * embed z ℓ‖ ≤
      ‖z ^ n * w - embed z ℓ'‖ + ‖z ^ n * w - z ^ n * embed z ℓ‖ := by
    calc ‖embed z ℓ' - z ^ n * embed z ℓ‖
        = ‖(z ^ n * w - z ^ n * embed z ℓ) - (z ^ n * w - embed z ℓ')‖ := by
          congr 1
          ring
      _ ≤ ‖z ^ n * w - z ^ n * embed z ℓ‖ + ‖z ^ n * w - embed z ℓ'‖ :=
          norm_sub_le _ _
      _ = ‖z ^ n * w - embed z ℓ'‖ + ‖z ^ n * w - z ^ n * embed z ℓ‖ := by
          ring
  linarith

name: PDT.Mahler.mahlerMeasure_multiset_prod_X_sub_C
statement:
lemma mahlerMeasure_multiset_prod_X_sub_C (s : Multiset ℂ) :
    ((s.map fun r => X - C r).prod).mahlerMeasure
      = (s.map fun r => max 1 ‖r‖).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [mahlerMeasure_one]
  | cons r s ih =>
      simp only [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons, mahlerMeasure_mul,
        mahlerMeasure_X_sub_C, ih]

name: PDT.Mahler.monic_eq_prod_roots
statement:
lemma monic_eq_prod_roots {p : ℂ[X]} (hm : p.Monic) :
    p = (p.roots.map fun r => X - C r).prod
proof:
:=
  (IsAlgClosed.splits p).eq_prod_roots_of_monic hm

name: PDT.Mahler.mahlerMeasure_eq_prod_roots
statement:
lemma mahlerMeasure_eq_prod_roots {p : ℂ[X]} (hm : p.Monic) :
    p.mahlerMeasure = (p.roots.map fun r => max 1 ‖r‖).prod
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [monic_eq_prod_roots hm]
  exact mahlerMeasure_multiset_prod_X_sub_C _

name: PDT.Mahler.q4_monic
statement: lemma q4_monic (a b c e : ℂ) : (q4 a b c e).Monic
proof:
:= by
  unfold q4; monicity!

name: PDT.Mahler.q4_natDegree
statement: lemma q4_natDegree (a b c e : ℂ) : (q4 a b c e).natDegree = 4
proof:
:= by
  unfold q4; compute_degree!

name: PDT.Mahler.q4_comp_neg
statement:
lemma q4_comp_neg (a b c e : ℂ) :
    (q4 a b c e).comp (-X) = q4 (-a) b (-c) e
proof:
:= by
  unfold q4
  simp only [add_comp, mul_comp, pow_comp, X_comp, C_comp, map_neg]
  ring

name: PDT.Mahler.prod_X_sub_C_comp_neg
statement:
lemma prod_X_sub_C_comp_neg (s : Multiset ℂ) :
    ((s.map fun r => X - C r).prod).comp (-X)
      = (-1) ^ (Multiset.card s) * (s.map fun r => X - C (-r)).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | cons r s ih =>
      simp only [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons, mul_comp, sub_comp,
        X_comp, C_comp, ih, Multiset.card_cons, map_neg]
      ring

name: PDT.Mahler.mahlerMeasure_comp_neg
statement:
lemma mahlerMeasure_comp_neg {p : ℂ[X]} (hm : p.Monic) :
    (p.comp (-X)).mahlerMeasure = p.mahlerMeasure
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [monic_eq_prod_roots hm]
  have hmap : (Multiset.map (fun r => X - C (-r)) p.roots)
      = Multiset.map (fun r => X - C r) (p.roots.map fun r => -r) := by
    rw [Multiset.map_map]; rfl
  rw [prod_X_sub_C_comp_neg, mahlerMeasure_mul, hmap,
    mahlerMeasure_multiset_prod_X_sub_C, mahlerMeasure_eq_prod_roots hm]
  have h1 : ((-1 : ℂ[X]) ^ Multiset.card p.roots).mahlerMeasure = 1 := by
    rcases Nat.even_or_odd (Multiset.card p.roots) with h | h
    · rw [h.neg_one_pow, mahlerMeasure_one]
    · rw [h.neg_one_pow, show ((-1 : ℂ[X])) = C (-1) by simp,
        mahlerMeasure_const]
      simp
  rw [h1, one_mul, Multiset.map_map]
  congr 1
  refine Multiset.map_congr rfl ?_
  intro r _
  simp

name: PDT.Mahler.comp_X_sq_injective
statement:
lemma comp_X_sq_injective {f g : ℂ[X]} (h : f.comp (X ^ 2) = g.comp (X ^ 2)) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.funext
  intro y
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq y zero_lt_two
  have h2 := congrArg (eval x) h
  simpa [eval_comp, hx] using h2

name: PDT.Mahler.gr4_ring
statement:
lemma gr4_ring (a b c e : ℂ) :
    q4 a b c e * q4 (-a) b (-c) e
      = (q4 (2*b - a^2) (b^2 - 2*a*c + 2*e) (2*b*e - c^2) (e^2)).comp (X ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold q4
  simp only [add_comp, mul_comp, pow_comp, X_comp, C_comp]
  simp only [map_sub, map_add, map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_ofNat]
  ring

name: PDT.Mahler.prod_X_sq_sub_sq
statement:
lemma prod_X_sq_sub_sq (s : Multiset ℂ) :
    (s.map fun r => X ^ 2 - C (r ^ 2)).prod
      = (s.map fun r => X - C r).prod * (s.map fun r => X + C r).prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Multiset.prod_map_mul]
  refine congrArg Multiset.prod (Multiset.map_congr rfl ?_)
  intro r _
  simp only [map_pow]
  ring

name: PDT.Mahler.q4_roots_card
statement:
lemma q4_roots_card (a b c e : ℂ) :
    Multiset.card (q4 a b c e).roots = 4
proof:
:= by
  have h := (IsAlgClosed.splits (k := ℂ) (q4 a b c e)).natDegree_eq_card_roots
  rw [q4_natDegree] at h
  omega

name: PDT.Mahler.prod_X_add_C_roots
statement:
lemma prod_X_add_C_roots (a b c e : ℂ) :
    (((q4 a b c e).roots).map fun r => X + C r).prod = q4 (-a) b (-c) e
proof:
:= by
  have h := prod_X_sub_C_comp_neg (q4 a b c e).roots
  rw [← monic_eq_prod_roots (q4_monic a b c e), q4_comp_neg, q4_roots_card,
    Even.neg_one_pow (by decide : Even 4), one_mul] at h
  rw [h]
  refine congrArg Multiset.prod (Multiset.map_congr rfl ?_)
  intro r _
  rw [map_neg, sub_neg_eq_add]

name: PDT.Mahler.max_one_norm_sq
statement: lemma max_one_norm_sq (r : ℂ) : max 1 ‖r ^ 2‖ = max 1 ‖r‖ * max 1 ‖r‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_pow]
  rcases le_total ‖r‖ 1 with h | h
  · rw [max_eq_left (pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg r) h), max_eq_left h, one_mul]
  · rw [max_eq_right (one_le_pow₀ h), max_eq_right h, pow_two]

name: PDT.Mahler.mahlerMeasure_gr4
statement:
lemma mahlerMeasure_gr4 (a b c e : ℂ) :
    (q4 (2*b - a^2) (b^2 - 2*a*c + 2*e) (2*b*e - c^2) (e^2)).mahlerMeasure
      = (q4 a b c e).mahlerMeasure ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have key : q4 (2*b - a^2) (b^2 - 2*a*c + 2*e) (2*b*e - c^2) (e^2)
      = (((q4 a b c e).roots.map fun r => r ^ 2).map fun r => X - C r).prod := by
    apply comp_X_sq_injective
    rw [multiset_prod_comp, Multiset.map_map, Multiset.map_map]
    simp only [Function.comp_def, sub_comp, X_comp, C_comp]
    rw [prod_X_sq_sub_sq, prod_X_add_C_roots,
      ← monic_eq_prod_roots (q4_monic a b c e), gr4_ring]
  rw [key, mahlerMeasure_multiset_prod_X_sub_C, Multiset.map_map,
    mahlerMeasure_eq_prod_roots (q4_monic a b c e), pow_two,
    ← Multiset.prod_map_mul]
  refine congrArg Multiset.prod (Multiset.map_congr rfl ?_)
  intro r _
  exact max_one_norm_sq r

name: PDT.Mahler.map_zq4
statement:
lemma map_zq4 (t : Z4) :
    (zq4 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)
      = q4 (t.1 : ℂ) (t.2.1 : ℂ) (t.2.2.1 : ℂ) (t.2.2.2 : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold zq4 q4
  simp [Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_pow, map_C]

name: PDT.Mahler.natDegree_map_zq4
statement:
lemma natDegree_map_zq4 (t : Z4) :
    ((zq4 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).natDegree = 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_zq4]; exact q4_natDegree _ _ _ _

name: PDT.Mahler.mahlerMeasure_map_gr4Z
statement:
lemma mahlerMeasure_map_gr4Z (t : Z4) :
    ((zq4 (gr4Z t)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
      = ((zq4 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, e⟩ := t
  rw [map_zq4, map_zq4]
  have harg : q4 ((gr4Z (a, b, c, e)).1 : ℂ) ((gr4Z (a, b, c, e)).2.1 : ℂ)
        ((gr4Z (a, b, c, e)).2.2.1 : ℂ) ((gr4Z (a, b, c, e)).2.2.2 : ℂ)
      = q4 (2*(b:ℂ) - (a:ℂ)^2) ((b:ℂ)^2 - 2*(a:ℂ)*(c:ℂ) + 2*(e:ℂ))
          (2*(b:ℂ)*(e:ℂ) - (c:ℂ)^2) ((e:ℂ)^2) := by
    show q4 ((2*b - a^2 : ℤ) : ℂ) ((b^2 - 2*a*c + 2*e : ℤ) : ℂ)
        ((2*b*e - c^2 : ℤ) : ℂ) ((e^2 : ℤ) : ℂ) = _
    congr 1 <;> push_cast <;> ring
  rw [harg, mahlerMeasure_gr4]

name: PDT.Mahler.mahlerMeasure_map_gr4Z_iterate
statement:
lemma mahlerMeasure_map_gr4Z_iterate (K : ℕ) (t : Z4) :
    ((zq4 (gr4Z^[K] t)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
      = ((zq4 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure ^ (2 ^ K)
proof:
:= by
  induction K generalizing t with
  | zero => simp
  | succ K ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply, ih (gr4Z t), mahlerMeasure_map_gr4Z,
        ← pow_mul]
      congr 1
      ring

name: PDT.Mahler.coeff_int_cast_CX
statement:
lemma coeff_int_cast_CX (n : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :
    ((n : ℂ[X])).coeff k = if k = 0 then (n : ℂ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Polynomial.C_eq_intCast, Polynomial.coeff_C]

name: PDT.Mahler.coeff_map_zq4
statement:
lemma coeff_map_zq4 (t : Z4) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ 4) :
    ((zq4 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).coeff k = (tupCoeff t k : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, e⟩ := t
  rw [map_zq4]
  interval_cases k <;> simp [q4, tupCoeff, coeff_int_cast_CX]

name: PDT.Mahler.lower_cert_sound
statement:
lemma lower_cert_sound {t : Z4} {P Q : ℕ} (hQ : 0 < Q) {K k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ 4)
    (h : (Nat.choose 4 k : ℤ) * (P : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ K)
        < |tupCoeff (gr4Z^[K] t) k| * (Q : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ K)) :
    (P : ℝ) / Q < ((zq4 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
proof:
:= by
  set M : ℝ := ((zq4 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure with hM
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := mahlerMeasure_nonneg _
  have hchoose : (0 : ℝ) < (Nat.choose 4 k : ℝ) :=
    Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.choose_pos hk)
  have hQ0 : (0 : ℝ) < (Q : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K) := by positivity
  
  have hbound := norm_coeff_le_choose_mul_mahlerMeasure k
      ((zq4 (gr4Z^[K] t)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ))
  rw [natDegree_map_zq4, mahlerMeasure_map_gr4Z_iterate,
    coeff_map_zq4 _ _ hk] at hbound
  simp only [Complex.norm_intCast] at hbound
  rw [← hM] at hbound
  
  have hR : (Nat.choose 4 k : ℝ) * (P : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K)
      < |((tupCoeff (gr4Z^[K] t) k : ℤ) : ℝ)| * (Q : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K) := by
    exact_mod_cast h
  
  have step1 : (Nat.choose 4 k : ℝ) * (P : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K)
      < (Nat.choose 4 k : ℝ) * (M ^ (2 ^ K) * (Q : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K)) :=
    calc (Nat.choose 4 k : ℝ) * (P : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K)
        < |((tupCoeff (gr4Z^[K] t) k : ℤ) : ℝ)| * (Q : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K) := hR
      _ ≤ (Nat.choose 4 k : ℝ) * M ^ (2 ^ K) * (Q : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbound (le_of_lt hQ0)
      _ = (Nat.choose 4 k : ℝ) * (M ^ (2 ^ K) * (Q : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K)) := by ring
  have hpow : ((P : ℝ) / Q) ^ (2 ^ K) < M ^ (2 ^ K) := by
    rw [div_pow, div_lt_iff₀ hQ0]
    exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left step1 (le_of_lt hchoose)
  exact lt_of_pow_lt_pow_left₀ _ hM0 hpow

name: PDT.Mahler.mahlerMeasure_map_zq4_le_l1
statement:
lemma mahlerMeasure_map_zq4_le_l1 (s : Z4) :
    ((zq4 s).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure ≤ (tupL1 s : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  refine (mahlerMeasure_le_sum_norm_coeff _).trans ?_
  rw [Polynomial.sum_def]
  have hsupp : ((zq4 s).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).support ⊆ Finset.range 5 := by
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.mem_range]
    have h1 := Polynomial.le_natDegree_of_mem_supp n hn
    rw [natDegree_map_zq4] at h1
    omega
  refine (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsupp
    (fun i _ _ => norm_nonneg _)).trans ?_
  rw [show (5 : ℕ) = 4 + 1 from rfl, Finset.sum_range_succ,
    Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ,
    Finset.sum_range_one]
  rw [coeff_map_zq4 _ 0 (by norm_num), coeff_map_zq4 _ 1 (by norm_num),
    coeff_map_zq4 _ 2 (by norm_num), coeff_map_zq4 _ 3 (by norm_num),
    coeff_map_zq4 _ 4 (by norm_num)]
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, e⟩ := s
  simp only [tupCoeff, tupL1, Complex.norm_intCast]
  push_cast
  rw [abs_one]
  linarith [abs_nonneg (a : ℝ), abs_nonneg (b : ℝ), abs_nonneg (c : ℝ),
    abs_nonneg (e : ℝ)]

name: PDT.Mahler.upper_cert_sound
proof:
:= by
  set M : ℝ := ((zq4 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure with hM
  have hQ0 : (0 : ℝ) < (Q : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K) := by positivity
  have hl1 := mahlerMeasure_map_zq4_le_l1 (gr4Z^[K] t)
  rw [mahlerMeasure_map_gr4Z_iterate, ← hM] at hl1
  have hR : (tupL1 (gr4Z^[K] t) : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K)
      ≤ (P : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K) := by exact_mod_cast h
  have hpow : M ^ (2 ^ K) ≤ ((P : ℝ) / Q) ^ (2 ^ K) := by
    rw [div_pow, le_div_iff₀ hQ0]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hl1 (le_of_lt hQ0)).trans hR
  exact le_of_pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (by positivity) hpow

name: PDT.Mahler.q4_roots_ne_zero
statement:
lemma q4_roots_ne_zero {a b c e : ℂ} (he : e ≠ 0) {r : ℂ}
    (hr : r ∈ (q4 a b c e).roots) : r ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  have h0 : (q4 a b c e).IsRoot 0 := isRoot_of_mem_roots hr
  simp [q4, IsRoot] at h0
  exact he h0

name: PDT.Mahler.prod_map_neg'
statement:
lemma prod_map_neg' (s : Multiset ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) :
    (s.map fun r => -(f r)).prod
      = (-1) ^ (Multiset.card s) * (s.map f).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | cons r s ih => simp only [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons, ih,
      Multiset.card_cons]; ring

name: PDT.Mahler.q4_prod_roots
statement: lemma q4_prod_roots (a b c e : ℂ) : (q4 a b c e).roots.prod = e
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (eval 0) (monic_eq_prod_roots (q4_monic a b c e))
  rw [eval_multiset_prod, Multiset.map_map] at h
  have h2 : eval 0 (q4 a b c e) = e := by simp [q4]
  have h3 : ((q4 a b c e).roots.map (eval 0 ∘ fun r => X - C r))
      = (q4 a b c e).roots.map fun r => -(id r) := by
    refine Multiset.map_congr rfl ?_
    intro r _
    simp
  rw [h2, h3, prod_map_neg', q4_roots_card,
    Even.neg_one_pow (by decide : Even 4), one_mul] at h
  simpa using h.symm

name: PDT.Mahler.norm_prod_multiset
statement:
lemma norm_prod_multiset (s : Multiset ℂ) :
    ‖s.prod‖ = (s.map fun z => ‖z‖).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | cons r s ih => simp [norm_mul, ih]

name: PDT.Mahler.max_one_norm_inv
statement:
lemma max_one_norm_inv {r : ℂ} (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    max 1 ‖r⁻¹‖ = max 1 ‖r‖ / ‖r‖
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) < ‖r‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hr
  rw [norm_inv]
  rcases le_total ‖r‖ 1 with h | h
  · rw [max_eq_right ((one_le_inv₀ h0).mpr h), max_eq_left h, one_div]
  · rw [max_eq_left ((inv_le_one₀ h0).mpr h), max_eq_right h,
      div_self (ne_of_gt h0)]

name: PDT.Mahler.prod_roots_inv
statement:
lemma prod_roots_inv (a b c e : ℂ) (he : e ≠ 0) :
    ((q4 a b c e).roots.map fun r => X - C r⁻¹).prod
      = q4 (c/e) (b/e) (a/e) (1/e)
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.funext
  intro y
  rw [eval_multiset_prod, Multiset.map_map]
  have hinv : ((q4 a b c e).roots.map fun r => r⁻¹).prod = e⁻¹ := by
    rw [Multiset.prod_map_inv]
    simp [q4_prod_roots]
  by_cases hy : y = 0
  · subst hy
    have hmap : ((q4 a b c e).roots.map (eval 0 ∘ fun r => X - C r⁻¹))
        = (q4 a b c e).roots.map fun r => -(fun r : ℂ => r⁻¹) r := by
      refine Multiset.map_congr rfl ?_
      intro r _
      simp
    rw [hmap, prod_map_neg' _ (fun r => r⁻¹), q4_roots_card,
      Even.neg_one_pow (by decide : Even 4), one_mul, hinv]
    simp only [q4, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_X, eval_C]
    ring_nf
  · have hstep : ((q4 a b c e).roots.map
          ((fun p => eval y p) ∘ fun r => X - C r⁻¹)).prod
        = ((q4 a b c e).roots.map fun r => r⁻¹ * (r * y - 1)).prod := by
      refine congrArg Multiset.prod (Multiset.map_congr rfl ?_)
      intro r hr
      have hr0 := q4_roots_ne_zero he hr
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]
      field_simp
    have hsplit : ((q4 a b c e).roots.map fun r => r⁻¹ * (r * y - 1)).prod
        = ((q4 a b c e).roots.map fun r => r⁻¹).prod
          * ((q4 a b c e).roots.map fun r => r * y - 1).prod := by
      rw [← Multiset.prod_map_mul]
    have hfactor : ((q4 a b c e).roots.map fun r => r * y - 1)
        = (q4 a b c e).roots.map fun r => y * (r - y⁻¹) := by
      refine Multiset.map_congr rfl ?_
      intro r _
      field_simp
    have hconst : ((q4 a b c e).roots.map fun _ => y).prod = y ^ 4 := by
      rw [Multiset.map_const', Multiset.prod_replicate, q4_roots_card]
    have hshift : ((q4 a b c e).roots.map fun r => r - y⁻¹).prod
        = eval y⁻¹ (q4 a b c e) := by
      conv_rhs => rw [monic_eq_prod_roots (q4_monic a b c e)]
      rw [eval_multiset_prod, Multiset.map_map]
      have : ((q4 a b c e).roots.map
            (eval y⁻¹ ∘ fun r => X - C r))
          = (q4 a b c e).roots.map fun r => -(fun r : ℂ => r - y⁻¹) r := by
        refine Multiset.map_congr rfl ?_
        intro r _
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]
        ring
      rw [this, prod_map_neg' _ (fun r => r - y⁻¹), q4_roots_card,
        Even.neg_one_pow (by decide : Even 4), one_mul]
    have hG : ((q4 a b c e).roots.map fun r => r * y - 1).prod
        = y ^ 4 * eval y⁻¹ (q4 a b c e) := by
      rw [hfactor]
      have hmul : ((q4 a b c e).roots.map fun r => y * (r - y⁻¹)).prod
          = ((q4 a b c e).roots.map fun _ => y).prod
            * ((q4 a b c e).roots.map fun r => r - y⁻¹).prod := by
        rw [← Multiset.prod_map_mul]
      rw [hmul, hconst, hshift]
    rw [hstep, hsplit, hinv, hG]
    simp only [q4, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_X, eval_C]
    field_simp
    ring

name: PDT.Mahler.mahlerMeasure_q4_inv
statement:
lemma mahlerMeasure_q4_inv (a b c e : ℂ) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) :
    (q4 (c/e) (b/e) (a/e) (1/e)).mahlerMeasure = (q4 a b c e).mahlerMeasure
proof:
:= by
  have he0 : e ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at he
    simp at he
  have hmap : ((q4 a b c e).roots.map fun r => X - C r⁻¹)
      = Multiset.map (fun r => X - C r) ((q4 a b c e).roots.map fun r => r⁻¹) := by
    rw [Multiset.map_map]
    rfl
  rw [← prod_roots_inv a b c e he0, hmap, mahlerMeasure_multiset_prod_X_sub_C,
    Multiset.map_map, mahlerMeasure_eq_prod_roots (q4_monic a b c e)]
  have hpt : ((q4 a b c e).roots.map
        ((fun r => max 1 ‖r‖) ∘ fun r => r⁻¹))
      = (q4 a b c e).roots.map fun r => max 1 ‖r‖ / ‖r‖ := by
    refine Multiset.map_congr rfl ?_
    intro r hr
    exact max_one_norm_inv (q4_roots_ne_zero he0 hr)
  rw [hpt]
  have hdiv : ((q4 a b c e).roots.map fun r => max 1 ‖r‖ / ‖r‖).prod
      = ((q4 a b c e).roots.map fun r => max 1 ‖r‖).prod
        / ((q4 a b c e).roots.map fun r => ‖r‖).prod := by
    rw [← Multiset.prod_map_div]
  have hnorm : ((q4 a b c e).roots.map fun r => ‖r‖).prod = 1 := by
    rw [← norm_prod_multiset, q4_prod_roots, he]
  rw [hdiv, hnorm, div_one]

name: PDT.Mahler.lowerHit_sound
proof:
:= by
  unfold lowerHit at h
  simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
  rcases h with ((h | h) | h) | h
  · have hc : ((Nat.choose 4 0 : ℕ) : ℤ) = 1 := by norm_num
    exact lower_cert_sound (K := K) (k := 0) hQ (by norm_num)
      (by rw [hc]; exact h)
  · have hc : ((Nat.choose 4 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = 4 := by norm_num
    exact lower_cert_sound (K := K) (k := 1) hQ (by norm_num)
      (by rw [hc]; exact h)
  · have hc : ((Nat.choose 4 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) = 6 := by norm_num [Nat.choose]
    exact lower_cert_sound (K := K) (k := 2) hQ (by norm_num)
      (by rw [hc]; exact h)
  · have hc : ((Nat.choose 4 3 : ℕ) : ℤ) = 4 := by norm_num [Nat.choose]
    exact lower_cert_sound (K := K) (k := 3) hQ (by norm_num)
      (by rw [hc]; exact h)

name: PDT.Mahler.lowerCert_sound
statement:
lemma lowerCert_sound {P Q : ℕ} (hQ : 0 < Q) :
    ∀ (fuel K : ℕ) (t : Z4),
      lowerCert fuel ((P : ℤ) ^ 2 ^ K) ((Q : ℤ) ^ 2 ^ K) (gr4Z^[K] t) = true →
      (P : ℝ) / Q < ((zq4 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
proof:
:= by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero => intro K t h; simp [lowerCert] at h
  | succ fuel ih =>
      intro K t h
      unfold lowerCert at h
      simp only [Bool.or_eq_true] at h
      rcases h with h1 | h2
      · exact lowerHit_sound hQ h1
      · have e1 : ((P : ℤ) ^ 2 ^ K) ^ 2 = (P : ℤ) ^ 2 ^ (K + 1) := by
          rw [← pow_mul, pow_succ]
        have e2 : ((Q : ℤ) ^ 2 ^ K) ^ 2 = (Q : ℤ) ^ 2 ^ (K + 1) := by
          rw [← pow_mul, pow_succ]
        have e3 : gr4Z (gr4Z^[K] t) = gr4Z^[K + 1] t :=
          (Function.iterate_succ_apply' gr4Z K t).symm
        rw [e1, e2, e3] at h2
        exact ih (K + 1) t h2

name: PDT.Mahler.lowerCert_139_sound
statement:
lemma lowerCert_139_sound {t : Z4} (h : lowerCert 9 139 100 t = true) :
    (139 : ℝ) / 100 < ((zq4 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
proof:
:= by
  have hs := lowerCert_sound (P := 139) (Q := 100) (by norm_num) 9 0 t
  simp only [pow_zero, pow_one, Function.iterate_zero_apply] at hs
  have h' : lowerCert 9 ((139 : ℕ) : ℤ) ((100 : ℕ) : ℤ) t = true := by
    exact_mod_cast h
  exact_mod_cast hs h'

name: PDT.cubicZ_monic
statement: lemma cubicZ_monic : (cubicZ).Monic
proof:
:= by
  unfold cubicZ
  monicity!

name: PDT.quarticZ_monic
statement: lemma quarticZ_monic : (quarticZ).Monic
proof:
:= by
  unfold quarticZ
  monicity!

name: PDT.cubicZ_map2
statement: lemma cubicZ_map2 : cubicZ.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod 2)) = X ^ 3 + X + 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold cubicZ
  simp only [Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.map_one]
  have h2 : (2 : (ZMod 2)[X]) = 0 := by
    have e : (2 : ZMod 2) = 0 := by decide
    calc (2 : (ZMod 2)[X]) = C (2 : ZMod 2) := (C_ofNat 2).symm
      _ = C (0 : ZMod 2) := by rw [e]
      _ = 0 := by simp
  linear_combination (-(X : (ZMod 2)[X]) - 1) * h2

name: PDT.cubic_irred_zmod2
statement: lemma cubic_irred_zmod2 : Irreducible (X ^ 3 + X + 1 : (ZMod 2)[X])
proof:
:= by
  apply irreducible_of_degree_le_three_of_not_isRoot
  · 
    have hd : (X ^ 3 + X + 1 : (ZMod 2)[X]).natDegree = 3 := by compute_degree!
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc, hd]
    omega
  · 
    intro x
    rw [IsRoot.def]
    simp only [eval_add, eval_pow, eval_X, eval_one]
    fin_cases x <;> decide

name: PDT.cubicZ_irred
statement: lemma cubicZ_irred : Irreducible cubicZ
proof:
:= by
  apply cubicZ_monic.irreducible_of_irreducible_map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod 2))
  rw [cubicZ_map2]
  exact cubic_irred_zmod2

name: PDT.cubicQ_irreducible
statement:
theorem cubicQ_irreducible :
    Irreducible (X ^ 3 - X - 1 : ℚ[X])
proof:
:= by
  have h := (cubicZ_monic.irreducible_iff_irreducible_map_fraction_map
    (K := ℚ)).mp cubicZ_irred
  have hmap : cubicZ.map (algebraMap ℤ ℚ) = (X ^ 3 - X - 1 : ℚ[X]) := by
    unfold cubicZ
    simp only [Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.map_one]
  rwa [hmap] at h

name: PDT.quarticZ_map2
statement: lemma quarticZ_map2 : quarticZ.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod 2)) = X ^ 4 + X + 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold quarticZ
  simp only [Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.map_one]
  have h2 : (2 : (ZMod 2)[X]) = 0 := by
    have e : (2 : ZMod 2) = 0 := by decide
    calc (2 : (ZMod 2)[X]) = C (2 : ZMod 2) := (C_ofNat 2).symm
      _ = C (0 : ZMod 2) := by rw [e]
      _ = 0 := by simp
  linear_combination (-(X : (ZMod 2)[X]) - 1) * h2

name: PDT.quartic_no_root_zmod2
statement: lemma quartic_no_root_zmod2 (x : ZMod 2) : ¬ (X ^ 4 + X + 1 : (ZMod 2)[X]).IsRoot x
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsRoot.def]
  simp only [eval_add, eval_pow, eval_X, eval_one]
  fin_cases x <;> decide

name: PDT.quad_irred_zmod2
statement: lemma quad_irred_zmod2 : Irreducible (X ^ 2 + X + 1 : (ZMod 2)[X])
proof:
:= by
  have hm : (X ^ 2 + X + 1 : (ZMod 2)[X]).Monic := by monicity!
  have hnd : (X ^ 2 + X + 1 : (ZMod 2)[X]).natDegree = 2 := by compute_degree!
  by_contra h
  rw [hm.not_irreducible_iff_exists_add_mul_eq_coeff hnd] at h
  obtain ⟨c₁, c₂, hmul, hadd⟩ := h
  have hc0 : (X ^ 2 + X + 1 : (ZMod 2)[X]).coeff 0 = 1 := by
    simp [coeff_add, coeff_X_pow, coeff_X, coeff_one]
  have hc1 : (X ^ 2 + X + 1 : (ZMod 2)[X]).coeff 1 = 1 := by
    simp [coeff_add, coeff_X_pow, coeff_X, coeff_one]
  rw [hc0] at hmul
  rw [hc1] at hadd
  revert hmul hadd
  fin_cases c₁ <;> fin_cases c₂ <;> decide

name: PDT.monic_deg2_no_root_eq
statement:
lemma monic_deg2_no_root_eq (q : (ZMod 2)[X]) (hm : q.Monic) (hnd : q.natDegree = 2)
    (hr : ∀ x, ¬ q.IsRoot x) : q = X ^ 2 + X + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hform : q = C (q.coeff 0) + C (q.coeff 1) * X + C (q.coeff 2) * X ^ 2 := by
    have h3 : q.natDegree < 3 := by omega
    have h := q.as_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow' h3
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_one] at h
    conv_lhs => rw [h]
    ring
  have hc2 : q.coeff 2 = 1 := by
    have := hm.coeff_natDegree
    rwa [hnd] at this
  
  have h0 := hr 0
  have h1 := hr 1
  rw [IsRoot.def, hform] at h0 h1
  simp only [eval_add, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_X, hc2,
    mul_zero, mul_one, pow_two, add_zero] at h0 h1
  
  have hcoeff0 : q.coeff 0 = 1 := by
    revert h0; generalize q.coeff 0 = a; clear hform; revert a; decide
  have hcoeff1 : q.coeff 1 = 1 := by
    rw [hcoeff0] at h1
    revert h1; generalize q.coeff 1 = b; clear hform; revert b; decide
  rw [hform, hc2, hcoeff0, hcoeff1, C_1]
  ring

name: PDT.quartic_irred_zmod2
statement: lemma quartic_irred_zmod2 : Irreducible (X ^ 4 + X + 1 : (ZMod 2)[X])
proof:
:= by
  set p : (ZMod 2)[X] := X ^ 4 + X + 1 with hp
  have hm : p.Monic := by rw [hp]; monicity!
  have hnd : p.natDegree = 4 := by rw [hp]; compute_degree!
  have hp1 : p ≠ 1 := by
    intro h; rw [h, natDegree_one] at hnd; exact absurd hnd (by norm_num)
  rw [hm.irreducible_iff_lt_natDegree_lt hp1]
  
  rw [hnd]
  intro q hqm hq hdvd
  rw [Finset.mem_Ioc] at hq
  obtain ⟨hq0, hq2⟩ := hq
  
  interval_cases hqd : q.natDegree
  · 
    have heq : q = X + C (q.coeff 0) := hqm.eq_X_add_C hqd
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hdvd
    set a := q.coeff 0 with ha
    
    have : p.IsRoot (-a) := by
      rw [IsRoot.def, hr, eval_mul, heq]
      simp only [eval_add, eval_X, eval_C, neg_add_cancel, zero_mul]
    rw [hp] at this
    exact quartic_no_root_zmod2 _ this
  · 
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hdvd
    have hrm : r.Monic := hqm.of_mul_monic_left (hr ▸ hm)
    have hrnd : r.natDegree = 2 := by
      have hdeg : q.natDegree + r.natDegree = 4 := by
        rw [← hqm.natDegree_mul hrm, ← hr, hnd]
      omega
    
    have hqnoroot : ∀ x, ¬ q.IsRoot x := by
      intro x hx
      have : p.IsRoot x := by
        rw [hr, IsRoot.def, eval_mul]
        rw [IsRoot.def] at hx; rw [hx, zero_mul]
      rw [hp] at this; exact quartic_no_root_zmod2 _ this
    have hrnoroot : ∀ x, ¬ r.IsRoot x := by
      intro x hx
      have : p.IsRoot x := by
        rw [hr, IsRoot.def, eval_mul]
        rw [IsRoot.def] at hx; rw [hx, mul_zero]
      rw [hp] at this; exact quartic_no_root_zmod2 _ this
    
    have hqeq : q = X ^ 2 + X + 1 := monic_deg2_no_root_eq q hqm hqd hqnoroot
    have hreq : r = X ^ 2 + X + 1 := monic_deg2_no_root_eq r hrm hrnd hrnoroot
    rw [hqeq, hreq, hp] at hr
    
    have hprod : (X ^ 2 + X + 1 : (ZMod 2)[X]) * (X ^ 2 + X + 1) = X ^ 4 + X ^ 2 + 1 := by
      have h2 : (2 : (ZMod 2)[X]) = 0 := by
        have e : (2 : ZMod 2) = 0 := by decide
        calc (2 : (ZMod 2)[X]) = C (2 : ZMod 2) := (C_ofNat 2).symm
          _ = C (0 : ZMod 2) := by rw [e]
          _ = 0 := by simp
      linear_combination (X ^ 3 + X ^ 2 + X) * h2
    rw [hprod] at hr
    
    have hc := congrArg (fun t => Polynomial.coeff t 1) hr
    simp only [coeff_add, coeff_X_pow, coeff_X, coeff_one] at hc
    exact absurd hc (by decide)

name: PDT.quarticZ_irred
statement: lemma quarticZ_irred : Irreducible quarticZ
proof:
:= by
  apply quarticZ_monic.irreducible_of_irreducible_map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod 2))
  rw [quarticZ_map2]
  exact quartic_irred_zmod2

name: PDT.quarticQ_irreducible
statement:
theorem quarticQ_irreducible :
    Irreducible (X ^ 4 - X - 1 : ℚ[X])
proof:
:= by

    (K := ℚ)).mp quarticZ_irred
  have hmap : quarticZ.map (algebraMap ℤ ℚ) = (X ^ 4 - X - 1 : ℚ[X]) := by

name: PDT.Mahler.theta_conj_norm_lt_one
statement:
theorem theta_conj_norm_lt_one (w : ℂ) (hw : w ^ 4 = w ^ 3 + 1)
    (him : w.im ≠ 0) : ‖w‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h] at hw; norm_num at hw
  set σ : ℝ := 2 * w.re with hσdef
  set s : ℝ := normSq w with hsdef
  have hspos : 0 < s := by rw [hsdef]; exact normSq_pos.mpr hw0
  have hsum : w + (starRingEnd ℂ) w = (σ : ℂ) := by rw [add_conj, hσdef]
  have hprod : w * (starRingEnd ℂ) w = (s : ℂ) := by rw [mul_conj, hsdef]
  have hquad : w ^ 2 = (σ : ℂ) * w - (s : ℂ) := by rw [← hsum, ← hprod]; ring
  have hred3 : w ^ 3 = ((σ:ℂ)^2 - (s:ℂ)) * w - (σ:ℂ)*(s:ℂ) := by
    calc w ^ 3 = w * w ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = w * ((σ:ℂ) * w - (s:ℂ)) := by rw [hquad]
      _ = (σ:ℂ) * w ^ 2 - (s:ℂ) * w := by ring
      _ = (σ:ℂ) * ((σ:ℂ) * w - (s:ℂ)) - (s:ℂ) * w := by rw [hquad]
      _ = ((σ:ℂ)^2 - (s:ℂ)) * w - (σ:ℂ)*(s:ℂ) := by ring
  have hred4 : w ^ 4 = ((σ:ℂ)^3 - 2*(s:ℂ)*(σ:ℂ)) * w
      + ((s:ℂ)^2 - (σ:ℂ)^2*(s:ℂ)) := by
    calc w ^ 4 = (w ^ 2) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = ((σ:ℂ) * w - (s:ℂ)) ^ 2 := by rw [hquad]
      _ = (σ:ℂ)^2 * w^2 - 2*(σ:ℂ)*(s:ℂ)*w + (s:ℂ)^2 := by ring
      _ = (σ:ℂ)^2 * ((σ:ℂ) * w - (s:ℂ)) - 2*(σ:ℂ)*(s:ℂ)*w + (s:ℂ)^2 := by
          rw [hquad]
      _ = ((σ:ℂ)^3 - 2*(s:ℂ)*(σ:ℂ)) * w + ((s:ℂ)^2 - (σ:ℂ)^2*(s:ℂ)) := by
          ring
  
  have hAB : (((σ:ℂ)^3 - 2*(s:ℂ)*(σ:ℂ)) - ((σ:ℂ)^2 - (s:ℂ))) * w
      + ((s:ℂ)^2 - (σ:ℂ)^2*(s:ℂ) + (σ:ℂ)*(s:ℂ) - 1) = 0 := by
    linear_combination hw - hred4 + hred3
  have hABc : (((σ:ℂ)^3 - 2*(s:ℂ)*(σ:ℂ)) - ((σ:ℂ)^2 - (s:ℂ)))
      * (starRingEnd ℂ) w
      + ((s:ℂ)^2 - (σ:ℂ)^2*(s:ℂ) + (σ:ℂ)*(s:ℂ) - 1) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (starRingEnd ℂ) hAB
    simpa [map_add, map_mul, map_sub, map_pow, map_one, map_ofNat,
      Complex.conj_ofReal] using h
  have hne : w - (starRingEnd ℂ) w ≠ 0 := by
    rw [sub_ne_zero]; intro h; exact him (Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp h.symm)
  have hA : ((σ:ℂ)^3 - 2*(s:ℂ)*(σ:ℂ)) - ((σ:ℂ)^2 - (s:ℂ)) = 0 := by
    have hfac : (((σ:ℂ)^3 - 2*(s:ℂ)*(σ:ℂ)) - ((σ:ℂ)^2 - (s:ℂ)))
        * (w - (starRingEnd ℂ) w) = 0 := by
      linear_combination hAB - hABc
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfac with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd h hne
  have hB : (s:ℂ)^2 - (σ:ℂ)^2*(s:ℂ) + (σ:ℂ)*(s:ℂ) - 1 = 0 := by
    linear_combination hAB - w * hA
  have hEqA' : σ^3 - 2*s*σ - (σ^2 - s) = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hA
  have hEqA : σ^3 - 2*s*σ - σ^2 + s = 0 := by linarith
  have hEqB : s^2 - σ^2*s + σ*s - 1 = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hB
  
  have hs1 : s < 1 := by
    by_contra hs1
    push_neg at hs1
    
    have hσcase : σ ≤ 0 ∨ 1 ≤ σ := by
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := hc
      nlinarith [mul_pos (mul_pos h0 hspos) (sub_pos.2 h1)]
    rcases hσcase with hσ0 | hσ1
    · 
      have hA' : s * (1 - 2*σ) = σ^2 * (1 - σ) := by linear_combination hEqA
      have h12 : (0:ℝ) < 1 - 2*σ := by linarith
      have hs_le : s ≤ σ^2 := by nlinarith [hA', h12, hσ0]
      have hs_gt : σ^2 - σ < s := by nlinarith [hEqB, hspos]
      linarith
    · 
      have hA'' : s * (2*σ - 1) = σ^2 * (σ - 1) := by linear_combination -hEqA
      have h21 : (0:ℝ) < 2*σ - 1 := by linarith
      have hpos : 0 < s + σ - σ^2 := by
        by_contra hp
        push_neg at hp
        nlinarith [hEqB, mul_nonneg hspos.le (neg_nonneg.2 hp)]
      have hgt : σ^2 - σ < s := by linarith
      have hstep := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hgt h21
      rw [hA''] at hstep
      nlinarith [hstep, hσ1, sq_nonneg (σ - 1), hspos, hA'', h21, hs1]
  have hnorm : ‖w‖ ^ 2 = s := by rw [hsdef]; exact (Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq w).symm
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg w, hs1, hnorm, sq_nonneg (‖w‖ - 1)]

name: PDT.Mahler.theta_real_root_cases
statement:
lemma theta_real_root_cases (x : ℝ) (hx : x ^ 4 = x ^ 3 + 1) :
    (-1 < x ∧ x < 0) ∨ (69/50 < x ∧ x < 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hne0 : x ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h] at hx; norm_num at hx
  rcases lt_trichotomy x 0 with hneg | hzero | hpos
  · left
    refine ⟨?_, hneg⟩
    by_contra hle
    push_neg at hle
    nlinarith [hx, mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_self_nonneg x) (neg_nonneg.2 hneg.le)) (neg_nonneg.2 hneg.le)]
  · exact absurd hzero hne0
  · right
    have h1 : 1 < x := by
      by_contra hle
      push_neg at hle
      nlinarith [pow_le_one₀ hpos.le hle (n := 3), hx, pow_pos hpos 3]
    constructor
    · by_contra hle
      push_neg at hle
      have h3 : x^3 ≤ (69/50)^3 := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hle)
          (by nlinarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ (69/50)^2 + (69/50)*x + x^2)]
      have hprod : x^3 * (x - 1) ≤ (69/50)^3 * (19/50) :=
        mul_le_mul h3 (by linarith) (by linarith) (by positivity)
      nlinarith [hx, hprod]
    · by_contra hle
      push_neg at hle
      have h8 : (8:ℝ) ≤ x^3 := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hle)
          (by nlinarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ x^2 + 2*x + 4)]
      have hprod : (8:ℝ) * 1 ≤ x^3 * (x - 1) :=
        mul_le_mul h8 (by linarith) (by norm_num) (by nlinarith)
      nlinarith [hx, hprod]

name: PDT.Mahler.theta_real_root_unique
statement:
lemma theta_real_root_unique {x y : ℝ} (hx : x ^ 4 = x ^ 3 + 1) (h1x : 1 < x)
    (hy : y ^ 4 = y ^ 3 + 1) (h1y : 1 < y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
  · nlinarith [hx, hy, mul_pos (sub_pos.2 h)
      (by nlinarith : (0:ℝ) < (y - 1) * (y^2 + y*x + x^2) + x^3)]
  · nlinarith [hx, hy, mul_pos (sub_pos.2 h)
      (by nlinarith : (0:ℝ) < (x - 1) * (x^2 + x*y + y^2) + y^3)]

name: PDT.Mahler.fam_lower_11
statement:
lemma fam_lower_11 :
    (11 : ℝ) / 10
      < ((zq4 (0, 0, -1, -1)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
proof:
:= by
  have hs := lowerCert_sound (P := 11) (Q := 10) (by norm_num) 9 0 (0, 0, -1, -1)
  simp only [pow_zero, pow_one, Function.iterate_zero_apply] at hs
  have h' : lowerCert 9 ((11 : ℕ) : ℤ) ((10 : ℕ) : ℤ) (0, 0, -1, -1) = true := by
    exact_mod_cast (by decide : lowerCert 9 (11 : ℤ) (10 : ℤ) (0, 0, -1, -1) = true)
  exact_mod_cast hs h'

name: PDT.Mahler.one_le_prod_max
statement:
lemma one_le_prod_max (s : Multiset ℂ) :
    1 ≤ (s.map fun r => max 1 ‖r‖).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | cons r s ih =>
      simp only [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons]
      calc (1:ℝ) = 1 * 1 := by norm_num
        _ ≤ max 1 ‖r‖ * (s.map fun r => max 1 ‖r‖).prod :=
            mul_le_mul (le_max_left _ _) ih (by norm_num)
              (le_trans (by norm_num) (le_max_left _ _))

name: PDT.Mahler.mahler_fam_pisot
statement:
theorem mahler_fam_pisot :
    (((zq4 (0, 0, -1, -1)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure) ^ 4
        = (((zq4 (0, 0, -1, -1)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure) ^ 3 + 1
      ∧ 1 < ((zq4 (0, 0, -1, -1)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
proof:
:= by
  
  have hswitch : ((zq4 (0, 0, -1, -1)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
      = (q4 (-1) 0 0 (-1)).mahlerMeasure := by
    rw [← tie_revneg_eq, map_zq4]
    push_cast
    norm_num
  set G : ℂ[X] := q4 (-1) 0 0 (-1) with hG
  have hroot_eq : ∀ r ∈ G.roots, r ^ 4 = r ^ 3 + 1 := by
    intro r hr
    have h := isRoot_of_mem_roots hr
    simp only [hG, IsRoot, q4, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_X, eval_C,
      map_neg, map_one, eval_neg, eval_one] at h
    linear_combination h
  
  have hMup : G.mahlerMeasure ≤ 139/100 := by
    rw [← hswitch]
    have h := fam_upper
    exact_mod_cast h
  have hMlow : 11/10 < G.mahlerMeasure := by
    rw [← hswitch]
    exact_mod_cast fam_lower_11
  have hMform : G.mahlerMeasure = (G.roots.map fun r => max 1 ‖r‖).prod :=
    mahlerMeasure_eq_prod_roots (q4_monic _ _ _ _)
  
  have hexists : ∃ r ∈ G.roots, 1 < ‖r‖ := by
    by_contra hall
    push_neg at hall
    have hone : ∀ r ∈ G.roots, max 1 ‖r‖ = 1 := fun r hr =>
      max_eq_left (hall r hr)
    rw [hMform, Multiset.map_congr rfl hone] at hMlow
    simp at hMlow
    linarith
  obtain ⟨rstar, hrmem, hrbig⟩ := hexists
  
  have hrim : rstar.im = 0 := by
    by_contra him
    exact absurd (theta_conj_norm_lt_one rstar (hroot_eq rstar hrmem) him)
      (not_lt.mpr hrbig.le)
  have hrre : rstar = ((rstar.re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hrim]
  set x : ℝ := rstar.re with hxdef
  have hxroot : x ^ 4 = x ^ 3 + 1 := by
    have h := hroot_eq rstar hrmem
    rw [hrre] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  have hxnorm : ‖rstar‖ = |x| := by rw [hrre]; exact Complex.norm_real _
  have hxbig : 69/50 < x ∧ x < 2 := by
    rcases theta_real_root_cases x hxroot with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | h
    · exfalso
      rw [hxnorm] at hrbig
      have : |x| < 1 := abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      linarith
    · exact h
  have hx1 : 1 < x := by linarith [hxbig.1]
  have hxpos : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hnormx : ‖rstar‖ = x := by rw [hxnorm, abs_of_pos hxpos]
  
  have hcount : Multiset.count rstar G.roots = 1 := by
    have hge : 1 ≤ Multiset.count rstar G.roots :=
      Multiset.one_le_count_iff_mem.mpr hrmem
    by_contra hne
    have h2 : 2 ≤ Multiset.count rstar G.roots := by omega
    have hrep : Multiset.replicate 2 rstar ≤ G.roots :=
      Multiset.le_count_iff_replicate_le.mp h2
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Multiset.le_iff_exists_add.mp hrep
    have : (G.roots.map fun r => max 1 ‖r‖).prod
        = (max 1 ‖rstar‖) ^ 2 * (u.map fun r => max 1 ‖r‖).prod := by
      rw [hu, Multiset.map_add, Multiset.prod_add, Multiset.map_replicate,
        Multiset.prod_replicate]
    rw [this] at hMform
    have hsq : (max 1 ‖rstar‖) ^ 2 = x ^ 2 := by
      rw [hnormx, max_eq_right hx1.le]
    rw [hsq] at hMform
    have hx2 : (69/50 : ℝ)^2 < x ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hxbig.1]
    nlinarith [hMform, hMup, one_le_prod_max u, hx2, sq_nonneg x]
  
  have herase : ∀ r ∈ G.roots.erase rstar, max 1 ‖r‖ = 1 := by
    intro r hr
    have hrmem' : r ∈ G.roots := Multiset.mem_of_mem_erase hr
    have hrne : r ≠ rstar := by
      intro h
      subst h
      have hcz : Multiset.count r (G.roots.erase r) = 0 := by
        simp [Multiset.count_erase_self, hcount]
      exact absurd hr (Multiset.count_eq_zero.mp hcz)
    apply max_eq_left
    by_cases him : r.im = 0
    · have hre : r = ((r.re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by apply Complex.ext <;> simp [him]
      have hroot' : r.re ^ 4 = r.re ^ 3 + 1 := by
        have h := hroot_eq r hrmem'
        rw [hre] at h
        exact_mod_cast h
      have hnr : ‖r‖ = |r.re| := by rw [hre]; exact Complex.norm_real _
      rcases theta_real_root_cases r.re hroot' with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
      · rw [hnr]
        rw [abs_le]
        constructor <;> linarith
      · exfalso
        apply hrne
        rw [hre, hrre]
        norm_cast
        exact theta_real_root_unique hroot' (by linarith) hxroot hx1
    · exact (theta_conj_norm_lt_one r (hroot_eq r hrmem') him).le
  
  have hMx : G.mahlerMeasure = x := by
    rw [hMform, ← Multiset.prod_map_erase (f := fun r => max 1 ‖r‖) hrmem]
    rw [Multiset.map_congr rfl herase]
    simp [hnormx, max_eq_right hx1.le]
  constructor
  · rw [hswitch, hMx]
    exact hxroot
  · rw [hswitch, hMx]
    exact hx1

name: BuschTheorem.homogeneity_automatic
statement:
theorem homogeneity_automatic {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (f : Matrix n n ℂ → ℝ)
    (h0 : ∀ a : Matrix n n ℂ, a.PosSemidef → (1 - a).PosSemidef → 0 ≤ f a)
    (hadd : ∀ a b : Matrix n n ℂ, a.PosSemidef → b.PosSemidef →
      (1 - (a + b)).PosSemidef → f (a + b) = f a + f b)
    (h1 : f 1 = 1)
    {a : Matrix n n ℂ} (ha : a.PosSemidef) (ha1 : (1 - a).PosSemidef)
    {t : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    f (t • a) = t * f a
proof:
:=
  PDT.Busch.frame_smul (toFrame h0 hadd h1) ha ha1 ht0 ht1

name: BuschTheorem.busch_representation
statement:
theorem busch_representation {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    [Nonempty n] (f : Matrix n n ℂ → ℝ)
    (h0 : ∀ a : Matrix n n ℂ, a.PosSemidef → (1 - a).PosSemidef → 0 ≤ f a)
    (hadd : ∀ a b : Matrix n n ℂ, a.PosSemidef → b.PosSemidef →
      (1 - (a + b)).PosSemidef → f (a + b) = f a + f b)
    (h1 : f 1 = 1) :
    ∃! ρ : Matrix n n ℂ, ρ.PosSemidef ∧ ρ.trace = 1 ∧
      ∀ a : Matrix n n ℂ, a.PosSemidef → (1 - a).PosSemidef →
        (ρ * a).trace = (f a : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρ, ⟨hpsd, htr, hrep⟩, huniq⟩ :=
    PDT.Busch.busch f (toFrame h0 hadd h1)
  refine ⟨ρ, ⟨hpsd, htr, fun a ha ha1 => hrep a ⟨ha, ha1⟩⟩, ?_⟩
  intro ρ' ⟨hpsd', htr', hrep'⟩
  exact huniq ρ' ⟨hpsd', htr', fun a ha => hrep' a ha.1 ha.2⟩

statement: lemma fc_monic : (fc).Monic
proof:

  unfold fc; monicity!

name: PDT.fc_deg
statement: lemma fc_deg : (fc).natDegree = 3
proof:

  unfold fc; compute_degree!

name: PDT.fc_degree
statement: lemma fc_degree : (fc).degree = 3
proof:

name: PDT.rootc_cubed

name: PDT.traceMatrix_fin3

    Algebra.traceMatrix ℚ ((powerBasis' fc_monic).basis ∘ (finCongr pdim).symm) =
      !![(3 : ℚ), 0, 2; 0, 2, 3; 2, 3, 2]
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [Algebra.traceMatrix_apply, Algebra.traceForm_apply]
  have hcomp : ∀ k : Fin 3, ((powerBasis' fc_monic).basis ∘ (finCongr pdim).symm) k
      = root fc ^ ((finCongr pdim).symm k : ℕ) := by
    intro k

  have he : ∀ k : Fin 3, ((finCongr pdim).symm k : ℕ) = (k : ℕ) := fun k => rfl
  rw [he, he]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    (simp only [Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_one, Fin.val_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Fin.isValue,
      Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val', Nat.reduceAdd]
     first
       | rw [p0] | rw [p1] | rw [p2] | rw [p3] | rw [p4]
     simp [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two,
