:=
  ⟨sigPos_traceQ, sigNeg_traceQ⟩

name: PDT.qTraceρ_apply
statement:
theorem qTraceρ_apply (x : AdjoinRoot fρ) :
    qTraceρ x = Algebra.trace ℚ (AdjoinRoot fρ) (x * x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [qTraceρ, LinearMap.BilinMap.toQuadraticMap_apply, Algebra.traceForm_apply]

name: PDT.traceForm_bρ
statement:
theorem traceForm_bρ (i j : Fin 3) :
    Algebra.traceForm ℚ (AdjoinRoot fρ) (bρ i) (bρ j) = Mρ i j
proof:
:= by
  have h : Algebra.traceMatrix ℚ (⇑bρ) i j
      = Algebra.traceForm ℚ (AdjoinRoot fρ) (bρ i) (bρ j) := by
    rw [Algebra.traceMatrix_apply]
  rw [traceMatrix_bρ] at h
  exact h.symm

name: PDT.qTraceρ_comb
statement:
theorem qTraceρ_comb (a₀ a₁ a₂ : ℚ) :
    qTraceρ (a₀ • bρ 0 + a₁ • bρ 1 + a₂ • bρ 2)
      = 3 * a₀ * a₀ + 4 * a₀ * a₂ + 2 * a₁ * a₁ + 6 * a₁ * a₂ + 2 * a₂ * a₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [qTraceρ, LinearMap.BilinMap.toQuadraticMap_apply]
  simp only [map_add, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    traceForm_bρ, Mρ, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
    Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons,
    Matrix.cons_val', Matrix.empty_val', Matrix.cons_val_fin_one, Matrix.head_fin_const]
  ring

name: PDT.cρ_apply
statement: theorem cρ_apply (i : Fin 3) : cρ i = ∑ j, Pρ j i • bρ j
proof:
:= by
  show (bρ.map (Matrix.toLinearEquiv bρ Pρ Pρ_isUnit)) i = _
  rw [Basis.map_apply]
  simp

name: PDT.sum_cρ
statement:
theorem sum_cρ (w : Fin 3 → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, w i • cρ i
      = (w 0 + (-2 / 3) * w 2) • bρ 0 + (w 1 + (-3 / 2) * w 2) • bρ 1 + (w 2) • bρ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cρ_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three, Pρ, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
    Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons,
    Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.cons_val', Matrix.empty_val', Matrix.cons_val_fin_one,
    Matrix.head_fin_const]
  module

name: PDT.basisRepr_cρ_apply
statement:
theorem basisRepr_cρ_apply (w : Fin 3 → ℚ) :
    qTraceρ.basisRepr cρ w = weightedSumSquares ℚ (fun i : Fin 3 => Dρ i i) w
proof:
:= by
  rw [QuadraticMap.basisRepr_apply, sum_cρ, qTraceρ_comb, weightedSumSquares_apply]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, smul_eq_mul, Dρ, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
    Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons,
    Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.cons_val', Matrix.empty_val', Matrix.cons_val_fin_one,
    Matrix.head_fin_const]
  ring

name: PDT.basisRepr_cρ
statement: theorem basisRepr_cρ : qTraceρ.basisRepr cρ = weightedSumSquares ℚ (fun i : Fin 3 => Dρ i i)
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  exact basisRepr_cρ_apply w

name: PDT.qTraceρ_equiv
statement:
theorem qTraceρ_equiv :
    QuadraticMap.Equivalent qTraceρ (weightedSumSquares ℚ (fun i : Fin 3 => Dρ i i))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  rw [← basisRepr_cρ]
  exact QuadraticMap.isometryEquivBasisRepr qTraceρ cρ

name: PDT.sigPos_traceρ
statement: theorem sigPos_traceρ : sigPos qTraceρ = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [QuadraticForm.sigPos_of_equiv_weightedSumSquares qTraceρ_equiv, Set.ncard_eq_two]
  refine ⟨0, 1, by decide, ?_⟩
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;> norm_num [Dρ]

name: PDT.sigNeg_traceρ
statement: theorem sigNeg_traceρ : sigNeg qTraceρ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [QuadraticForm.sigNeg_of_equiv_weightedSumSquares qTraceρ_equiv, Set.ncard_eq_one]
  refine ⟨2, ?_⟩
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;> norm_num [Dρ] <;> decide

name: PDT.traceForm_signature_ρ
statement: theorem traceForm_signature_ρ : sigPos qTraceρ = 2 ∧ sigNeg qTraceρ = 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨sigPos_traceρ, sigNeg_traceρ⟩

name: PDT.HamiltonianBoundary.radial_phase_decomposition
statement:
theorem radial_phase_decomposition (σ : ℂ) :
    (‖σ‖ : ℂ) * unitaryPhase σ = σ
proof:
:= by
  exact Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I σ

name: PDT.HamiltonianBoundary.unitaryPhase_norm
statement: theorem unitaryPhase_norm (σ : ℂ) : ‖unitaryPhase σ‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  exact Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I (Complex.arg σ)

name: PDT.HamiltonianBoundary.unitaryPhase_eq_div_norm
statement:
theorem unitaryPhase_eq_div_norm {σ : ℂ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0) :
    unitaryPhase σ = σ / (‖σ‖ : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (‖σ‖ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hσ)
  apply (eq_div_iff hn).2
  simpa [mul_comm] using radial_phase_decomposition σ

name: PDT.HamiltonianBoundary.scalarEvolution_norm
statement: theorem scalarEvolution_norm (h dt : ℝ) : ‖scalarEvolution h dt‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [scalarEvolution, Complex.norm_exp]
  simp

name: PDT.HamiltonianBoundary.no_scalarHamiltonian_for_raw_tick
statement:
theorem no_scalarHamiltonian_for_raw_tick {σ : ℂ} (hnorm : ‖σ‖ ≠ 1)
    (dt : ℝ) : ¬ ∃ h : ℝ, scalarEvolution h dt = σ
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨h, heq⟩
  apply hnorm
  rw [← heq]
  exact scalarEvolution_norm h dt

name: PDT.HamiltonianBoundary.scalarHamiltonian_generates_phase
statement:
theorem scalarHamiltonian_generates_phase (σ : ℂ) {dt : ℝ} (hdt : 0 < dt)
    (k : ℤ) : scalarEvolution (scalarHamiltonian σ dt k) dt = unitaryPhase σ
proof:
:= by
  have hdt0 : dt ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hdt
  unfold scalarEvolution scalarHamiltonian unitaryPhase
  have hreal : -(((2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) - Complex.arg σ) / dt) * dt) =
      Complex.arg σ - 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  have hcomplex :
      -(↑((2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) - Complex.arg σ) / dt) * ↑dt : ℂ) =
        ((Complex.arg σ - 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hreal
  rw [hcomplex]
  apply Complex.exp_eq_exp_iff_exists_int.mpr
  refine ⟨-k, ?_⟩
  push_cast
  ring

name: PDT.HamiltonianBoundary.scalarEvolution_eq_phase_iff
statement:
theorem scalarEvolution_eq_phase_iff (σ : ℂ) {dt : ℝ} (hdt : 0 < dt) (h : ℝ) :
    scalarEvolution h dt = unitaryPhase σ ↔
      ∃ k : ℤ, h = scalarHamiltonian σ dt k
proof:
:= by
  have hdt0 : dt ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hdt
  constructor
  · intro heq
    unfold scalarEvolution unitaryPhase at heq
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Complex.exp_eq_exp_iff_exists_int.mp heq
    refine ⟨-n, ?_⟩
    unfold scalarHamiltonian
    have hI :
        -(↑h * ↑dt) * Complex.I =
          ((Complex.arg σ + (n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
      rw [hn]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hreal : -(h * dt) = Complex.arg σ + (n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
      have hcancel := mul_right_cancel₀ Complex.I_ne_zero hI
      exact_mod_cast hcancel
    apply (eq_div_iff hdt0).2
    push_cast at hreal ⊢
    linarith
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact scalarHamiltonian_generates_phase σ hdt k

name: PDT.HamiltonianBoundary.scalarHamiltonian_sub
statement:
theorem scalarHamiltonian_sub (σ : ℂ) {dt : ℝ} (hdt : 0 < dt) (k m : ℤ) :
    scalarHamiltonian σ dt k - scalarHamiltonian σ dt m =
      2 * Real.pi * ((k - m : ℤ) : ℝ) / dt
proof:
:= by
  have hdt0 : dt ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hdt
  unfold scalarHamiltonian
  field_simp
  push_cast
  ring

name: PDT.HamiltonianBoundary.cubic_quartic_raw_ticks_not_scalarHamiltonian
statement:
theorem cubic_quartic_raw_ticks_not_scalarHamiltonian
    {z w : ℂ} (hz : z ^ 3 = z + 1) (hzim : z.im ≠ 0)
    (hw : w ^ 4 = w + 1) (hwim : w.im ≠ 0) (dt : ℝ) :
    (‖z‖ < 1 ∧ ¬ ∃ h : ℝ, scalarEvolution h dt = z) ∧
      (1 < ‖w‖ ∧ ¬ ∃ h : ℝ, scalarEvolution h dt = w)
proof:
:= by
  have hzlt := PDT.cubic_conj_norm_lt_one z hz hzim
  have hwgt := PDT.quartic_conj_norm_gt_one w hw hwim
  exact ⟨⟨hzlt, no_scalarHamiltonian_for_raw_tick (ne_of_lt hzlt) dt⟩,
    ⟨hwgt, no_scalarHamiltonian_for_raw_tick (ne_of_gt hwgt) dt⟩⟩

name: PDT.perm_four_eq_top
statement:
theorem perm_four_eq_top {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (hα : Fintype.card α = 4)
    (H : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm α)) (h4 : 4 ∣ Nat.card H) (h3 : 3 ∣ Nat.card H)
    {τ : Equiv.Perm α} (hτ : τ ∈ H) (hswap : τ.IsSwap) : H = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h12 : 12 ∣ Nat.card H := Nat.Coprime.mul_dvd_of_dvd_of_dvd (by norm_num) h4 h3
  have hcard : Nat.card (Equiv.Perm α) = 24 := by
    rw [Nat.card_perm, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hα]; rfl
  have hmul := H.index_mul_card
  rw [hcard] at hmul
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h12
  have hik : H.index * k = 2 := by
    apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (show 0 < 12 by norm_num)
    rw [show 12 * (H.index * k) = H.index * (12 * k) by ring, ← hk, hmul]
  have hidx : H.index ∣ 2 := Dvd.intro k hik
  rcases (Nat.dvd_prime Nat.prime_two).mp hidx with h1 | h2
  · exact Subgroup.index_eq_one.mp h1
  · exfalso
    rw [Equiv.Perm.eq_alternatingGroup_of_index_eq_two h2, Equiv.Perm.mem_alternatingGroup,
      hswap.sign_eq] at hτ
    exact units_ne_neg_self (1 : ℤˣ) hτ.symm

name: PDT.natDegree_dvd_card_gal
statement:
theorem natDegree_dvd_card_gal {p : ℚ[X]} (p_irr : Irreducible p) :
    p.natDegree ∣ Nat.card p.Gal
proof:
:= by
  rw [Gal.card_of_separable p_irr.separable]
  have hp : p.degree ≠ 0 := (degree_pos_of_irreducible p_irr).ne'
  let α : p.SplittingField := rootOfSplits (SplittingField.splits p) (by rwa [degree_map])
  have hα : IsIntegral ℚ α := .of_finite ℚ α
  use Module.finrank ℚ⟮α⟯ p.SplittingField
  suffices (minpoly ℚ α).natDegree = p.natDegree by
    letI _ : AddCommGroup ℚ⟮α⟯ := Ring.toAddCommGroup
    rw [← Module.finrank_mul_finrank ℚ ℚ⟮α⟯ p.SplittingField,
      IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank hα, this]
  suffices minpoly ℚ α ∣ p by
    have key := (minpoly.irreducible hα).dvd_symm p_irr this
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact natDegree_le_of_dvd this p_irr.ne_zero
    · exact natDegree_le_of_dvd key (minpoly.ne_zero hα)
  apply minpoly.dvd ℚ α
  rw [← eval_map_algebraMap]
  exact eval_rootOfSplits (SplittingField.splits p) (by rwa [degree_map])

name: PDT.resolventCubic_monic
statement: theorem resolventCubic_monic (p : ℚ[X]) : (resolventCubic p).Monic
proof:
:= by
  unfold resolventCubic; monicity!

name: PDT.resolventCubic_natDegree
statement: theorem resolventCubic_natDegree (p : ℚ[X]) : (resolventCubic p).natDegree = 3
proof:
:= by
  unfold resolventCubic; compute_degree!

name: PDT.prod_four_linear
statement:
theorem prod_four_linear {E : Type*} [CommRing E] (r₁ r₂ r₃ r₄ : E) :
    (X - C r₁) * ((X - C r₂) * ((X - C r₃) * (X - C r₄)))
      = X ^ 4 - C (r₁ + r₂ + r₃ + r₄) * X ^ 3
        + C (r₁ * r₂ + r₁ * r₃ + r₁ * r₄ + r₂ * r₃ + r₂ * r₄ + r₃ * r₄) * X ^ 2
        - C (r₁ * r₂ * r₃ + r₁ * r₂ * r₄ + r₁ * r₃ * r₄ + r₂ * r₃ * r₄) * X
        + C (r₁ * r₂ * r₃ * r₄)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map_add, map_mul]; ring

name: PDT.quartic_eq_sum
statement:
theorem quartic_eq_sum {p : ℚ[X]} (hm : p.Monic) (hd : p.natDegree = 4) :
    p = X ^ 4 + C (p.coeff 3) * X ^ 3 + C (p.coeff 2) * X ^ 2 + C (p.coeff 1) * X
      + C (p.coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h4 : p.coeff 4 = 1 := by rw [← hd]; exact hm.coeff_natDegree
  have h := p.as_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow' (n := 5) (by omega)
  conv_lhs => rw [h]
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, h4, C_1]
  ring

name: PDT.exists_resolvent_root_of_splits
proof:
:= by
  have hm' : (p.map (algebraMap ℚ E)).Monic := hm.map _
  have hcard : Multiset.card (p.map (algebraMap ℚ E)).roots = 4 := by
    rw [← hs.natDegree_eq_card_roots, natDegree_map, hd]
  obtain ⟨r₁, r₂, r₃, r₄, hr⟩ := Multiset.card_eq_four.mp hcard
  have hprod := hs.eq_prod_roots_of_monic hm'
  rw [hr] at hprod
  simp only [Multiset.insert_eq_cons, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.map_singleton,
    Multiset.prod_cons, Multiset.prod_singleton] at hprod
  rw [prod_four_linear] at hprod
  have hmap : p.map (algebraMap ℚ E)
      = X ^ 4 + C (algebraMap ℚ E (p.coeff 3)) * X ^ 3 + C (algebraMap ℚ E (p.coeff 2)) * X ^ 2
        + C (algebraMap ℚ E (p.coeff 1)) * X + C (algebraMap ℚ E (p.coeff 0)) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [quartic_eq_sum hm hd]
    simp only [Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_X,
      Polynomial.map_C]
  rw [hmap] at hprod
  have h3 := Polynomial.ext_iff.mp hprod 3
  have h2 := Polynomial.ext_iff.mp hprod 2
  have h1 := Polynomial.ext_iff.mp hprod 1
  have h0 := Polynomial.ext_iff.mp hprod 0
  simp only [coeff_add, coeff_sub, coeff_C_mul, coeff_X_pow, coeff_X, coeff_C] at h3 h2 h1 h0
  norm_num at h3 h2 h1 h0
  have e3 : ((p.coeff 3 : ℚ) : E) = -(r₁ + r₂ + r₃ + r₄) := by linear_combination h3
  have e2 : ((p.coeff 2 : ℚ) : E)
      = r₁ * r₂ + r₁ * r₃ + r₁ * r₄ + r₂ * r₃ + r₂ * r₄ + r₃ * r₄ := by linear_combination h2
  have e1 : ((p.coeff 1 : ℚ) : E)
      = -(r₁ * r₂ * r₃ + r₁ * r₂ * r₄ + r₁ * r₃ * r₄ + r₂ * r₃ * r₄) := by linear_combination h1
  have e0 : ((p.coeff 0 : ℚ) : E) = r₁ * r₂ * r₃ * r₄ := by linear_combination h0
  refine ⟨r₁ * r₂ + r₃ * r₄, ?_⟩
  simp only [resolventCubic, map_sub, map_add, map_mul, map_pow, aeval_X, aeval_C, map_ofNat,
    eq_ratCast]
  rw [e3, e2, e1, e0]
  ring

name: PDT.three_dvd_card_gal
statement:
theorem three_dvd_card_gal {p : ℚ[X]} (p_irr : Irreducible p) (hm : p.Monic)
    (hd : p.natDegree = 4) (h_res : Irreducible (resolventCubic p)) : 3 ∣ Nat.card p.Gal
proof:
:= by
  rw [Gal.card_of_separable p_irr.separable]
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ⟩ := exists_resolvent_root_of_splits hm hd (SplittingField.splits p)
  have hθi : IsIntegral ℚ θ := .of_finite ℚ θ
  have hmin : resolventCubic p = minpoly ℚ θ :=
    minpoly.eq_of_irreducible_of_monic h_res hθ (resolventCubic_monic p)
  use Module.finrank ℚ⟮θ⟯ p.SplittingField
  letI _ : AddCommGroup ℚ⟮θ⟯ := Ring.toAddCommGroup
  rw [← Module.finrank_mul_finrank ℚ ℚ⟮θ⟯ p.SplittingField, IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank hθi,
    ← hmin, resolventCubic_natDegree]

name: PDT.card_rootSet_complex
statement:
theorem card_rootSet_complex {p : ℚ[X]} (p_irr : Irreducible p) :
    Fintype.card (p.rootSet ℂ) = p.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp_rw [rootSet_def, Finset.coe_sort_coe, Fintype.card_coe]
  rw [Multiset.toFinset_card_of_nodup, ← Splits.natDegree_eq_card_roots, natDegree_map]
  · exact IsAlgClosed.splits _
  · exact nodup_roots ((separable_map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ)).mpr p_irr.separable)

name: PDT.galActionHom_bijective_of_quartic
statement:
theorem galActionHom_bijective_of_quartic {p : ℚ[X]} (p_irr : Irreducible p)
    (p_deg : p.natDegree = 4) (p_monic : p.Monic)
    (p_roots : Fintype.card (p.rootSet ℂ) = Fintype.card (p.rootSet ℝ) + 2)
    (h_res : Irreducible (resolventCubic p)) : Function.Bijective (Gal.galActionHom p ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h1 : Fintype.card (p.rootSet ℂ) = 4 := by rw [card_rootSet_complex p_irr, p_deg]
  have hcard : Nat.card p.Gal = Nat.card (Gal.galActionHom p ℂ).range :=
    Nat.card_congr (MonoidHom.ofInjective (Gal.galActionHom_injective p ℂ)).toEquiv
  refine ⟨Gal.galActionHom_injective p ℂ, fun x =>
    (congr_arg (x ∈ ·) (show (Gal.galActionHom p ℂ).range = ⊤ from ?_)).mpr (Subgroup.mem_top x)⟩
  refine perm_four_eq_top h1 _ ?_ ?_
    (τ := Gal.galActionHom p ℂ (Gal.restrict p ℂ (Complex.conjAe.restrictScalars ℚ))) ⟨_, rfl⟩ ?_
  · rw [← hcard, ← p_deg]; exact natDegree_dvd_card_gal p_irr
  · rw [← hcard]; exact three_dvd_card_gal p_irr p_monic p_deg h_res
  · rw [← Equiv.Perm.card_support_eq_two]
    apply Nat.add_left_cancel
    rw [← p_roots, ← Set.toFinset_card (rootSet p ℝ), ← Set.toFinset_card (rootSet p ℂ)]
    exact (Gal.card_complex_roots_eq_card_real_add_card_not_gal_inv p).symm

name: PDT.cubic_real_root_gt_one
statement: theorem cubic_real_root_gt_one {x : ℝ} (hx : x ^ 3 = x + 1) : 1 < x
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hle
  push_neg at hle
  rcases le_or_gt x (-1) with h | h
  · nlinarith [hx, mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg
      (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ -x) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - x))
      (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ -1 - x)]
  · rcases le_or_gt x 0 with h0 | h0
    · nlinarith [hx, (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < x + 1),
        mul_nonneg (neg_nonneg.2 h0) (mul_self_nonneg x)]
    · nlinarith [hx, mul_nonneg h0.le (by nlinarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - x ^ 2)]

name: PDT.cubic_real_root_unique
statement:
theorem cubic_real_root_unique {x y : ℝ} (hx : x ^ 3 = x + 1) (h1x : 1 < x)
    (hy : y ^ 3 = y + 1) (h1y : 1 < y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
  · nlinarith [hx, hy, mul_pos (sub_pos.2 h)
      (by nlinarith : (0:ℝ) < y ^ 2 + y * x + x ^ 2 - 1)]
  · nlinarith [hx, hy, mul_pos (sub_pos.2 h)
      (by nlinarith : (0:ℝ) < x ^ 2 + x * y + y ^ 2 - 1)]

name: PDT.cubic_rootSet_real_card
statement: theorem cubic_rootSet_real_card : Fintype.card ((X ^ 3 - X - 1 : ℚ[X]).rootSet ℝ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.card_eq_one_iff]
  have hivt := intermediate_value_Icc (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) ≤ 2)
    (f := fun x : ℝ => x ^ 3 - x - 1) (by fun_prop)
  obtain ⟨ρ, -, hρ⟩ := hivt (show (0:ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ 3 - x - 1) 1)
    ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ 3 - x - 1) 2) by norm_num)
  have hρ' : ρ ^ 3 - ρ - 1 = 0 := hρ
  have hne : (X ^ 3 - X - 1 : ℚ[X]) ≠ 0 := cubicQ_irreducible.ne_zero
  refine ⟨⟨ρ, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [mem_rootSet]
    refine ⟨hne, ?_⟩
    simp only [map_sub, map_pow, map_one, aeval_X]
    exact hρ'
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [mem_rootSet] at hy
    have hy' : y ^ 3 - y - 1 = 0 := by simpa only [map_sub, map_pow, map_one, aeval_X] using hy.2
    exact Subtype.ext (cubic_real_root_unique (by linarith) (cubic_real_root_gt_one (by linarith))
      (by linarith) (cubic_real_root_gt_one (by linarith)))

name: PDT.cubic_rootSet_complex_card
statement: theorem cubic_rootSet_complex_card : Fintype.card ((X ^ 3 - X - 1 : ℚ[X]).rootSet ℂ) = 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_rootSet_complex cubicQ_irreducible]; compute_degree!

name: PDT.gal_cubic_bijective

    (derivative (X ^ 4 - X - 1 : ℝ[X])).roots.toFinset.card ≤ 1
proof:

name: PDT.quarticR_roots_card_ge
statement: theorem quarticR_roots_card_ge : 2 ≤ (X ^ 4 - X - 1 : ℝ[X]).roots.toFinset.card
proof:
:= by
  have hf : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 4 - x - 1) (Set.Icc (-1) 0) := by fun_prop
  have hg : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 4 - x - 1) (Set.Icc 1 2) := by fun_prop
  obtain ⟨r₁, ⟨-, h1b⟩, hr₁⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc' (by norm_num : (-1:ℝ) ≤ 0) hf
    (show (0:ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ 4 - x - 1) 0) ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ 4 - x - 1) (-1))
      by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨r₂, ⟨h2a, -⟩, hr₂⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) ≤ 2) hg
    (show (0:ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ 4 - x - 1) 1) ((fun x : ℝ => x ^ 4 - x - 1) 2)
      by norm_num)
  have hr₁' : r₁ ^ 4 - r₁ - 1 = 0 := hr₁
  have hr₂' : r₂ ^ 4 - r₂ - 1 = 0 := hr₂
  show 1 < _
  apply Finset.one_lt_card.mpr
  refine ⟨r₁, ?_, r₂, ?_, ne_of_lt (by linarith)⟩
  · rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, mem_roots quarticR_ne_zero, IsRoot.def]
    simp only [eval_sub, eval_pow, eval_X, eval_one]
    exact hr₁'
  · rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, mem_roots quarticR_ne_zero, IsRoot.def]
    simp only [eval_sub, eval_pow, eval_X, eval_one]
    exact hr₂'

name: PDT.pow_ne_ratCast
statement:
theorem pow_ne_ratCast {x : ℝ} (hx1 : 1 < x) (hi : IsIntegral ℤ x) (hi' : IsIntegral ℤ x⁻¹)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (q : ℚ) : x ^ n ≠ q
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, Rat.cast_zero] at h
    exact (pow_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < x) n).ne' h
  have hq : IsIntegral ℤ q := by
    rw [← isIntegral_algebraMap_iff (algebraMap ℚ ℝ).injective, eq_ratCast, ← h]
    exact hi.pow n
  have hq' : IsIntegral ℤ q⁻¹ := by
    rw [← isIntegral_algebraMap_iff (algebraMap ℚ ℝ).injective, map_inv₀, eq_ratCast, ← h,
      ← inv_pow]
    exact hi'.pow n
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff.mp hq
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff.mp hq'
  have hmk : m * k = 1 := by
    have h1 : algebraMap ℤ ℚ m * algebraMap ℤ ℚ k = 1 := by
      rw [hm, hk]; exact mul_inv_cancel₀ hq0
    simp only [eq_intCast] at h1
    exact_mod_cast h1
  have h1 : 1 < x ^ n := one_lt_pow₀ hx1 hn
  rw [h, ← hm] at h1
  rcases Int.eq_one_or_neg_one_of_mul_eq_one hmk with rfl | rfl
  · norm_num at h1
  · norm_num at h1

name: PDT.adjoin_inf_eq_bot
statement:
theorem adjoin_inf_eq_bot {ρ Q : ℝ} (hρ : ρ ^ 3 = ρ + 1) (hQ : Q ^ 4 = Q + 1) :
    ℚ⟮ρ⟯ ⊓ ℚ⟮Q⟯ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have hρ0 : aeval ρ (X ^ 3 - X - 1 : ℚ[X]) = 0 := by
    simp only [map_sub, map_pow, map_one, aeval_X]; linarith
  have hQ0 : aeval Q (X ^ 4 - X - 1 : ℚ[X]) = 0 := by
    simp only [map_sub, map_pow, map_one, aeval_X]; linarith
  have hρi : IsIntegral ℚ ρ := ⟨X ^ 3 - X - 1, by monicity!, by rwa [← aeval_def]⟩
  have hQi : IsIntegral ℚ Q := ⟨X ^ 4 - X - 1, by monicity!, by rwa [← aeval_def]⟩
  have h1 : minpoly ℚ ρ = X ^ 3 - X - 1 :=
    (minpoly.eq_of_irreducible_of_monic cubicQ_irreducible hρ0 (by monicity!)).symm
  have h2 : minpoly ℚ Q = X ^ 4 - X - 1 :=
    (minpoly.eq_of_irreducible_of_monic quarticQ_irreducible hQ0 (by monicity!)).symm
  apply IntermediateField.LinearDisjoint.inf_eq_bot
  apply IntermediateField.LinearDisjoint.of_finrank_coprime
  rw [IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank hρi, IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank hQi, h1, h2,
    show (X ^ 3 - X - 1 : ℚ[X]).natDegree = 3 by compute_degree!,
    show (X ^ 4 - X - 1 : ℚ[X]).natDegree = 4 by compute_degree!]
  decide

name: PDT.mul_indep
statement:
theorem mul_indep {ρ Q : ℝ} (hρ : ρ ^ 3 = ρ + 1) (hρ1 : 1 < ρ) (hQ : Q ^ 4 = Q + 1) (hQ1 : 1 < Q)
    (a b : ℤ) (h : ρ ^ a * Q ^ b = 1) : a = 0 ∧ b = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hx : ρ ^ a ∈ ℚ⟮ρ⟯ ⊓ ℚ⟮Q⟯ := by
    rw [IntermediateField.mem_inf]
    constructor
    · exact zpow_mem (IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self ℚ ρ) a
    · have hρQ : ρ ^ a = Q ^ (-b) := by rw [zpow_neg]; exact eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left h
      rw [hρQ]
      exact zpow_mem (IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self ℚ Q) (-b)
  rw [adjoin_inf_eq_bot hρ hQ, IntermediateField.mem_bot] at hx
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hx
  have ha : a = 0 := by
    by_contra ha
    have hi := cubic_root_isIntegral hρ
    have hi' := cubic_root_inv_isIntegral hρ
    rcases Int.eq_nat_or_neg a with ⟨n, rfl | rfl⟩
    · have hn : n ≠ 0 := by omega
      apply pow_ne_ratCast hρ1 hi hi' hn q
      rw [← eq_ratCast (algebraMap ℚ ℝ) q, hq, zpow_natCast]
    · have hn : n ≠ 0 := by omega
      apply pow_ne_ratCast hρ1 hi hi' hn q⁻¹
      rw [Rat.cast_inv, ← eq_ratCast (algebraMap ℚ ℝ) q, hq, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, inv_inv]
  subst ha
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  rw [zpow_zero, one_mul] at h
  exact zpow_right_injective₀ (by linarith) hQ1.ne' (h.trans (zpow_zero Q).symm)

  have h2 : -z.im = z.im := by rw [← Complex.conj_im]; exact congrArg Complex.im h
  linarith

name: PDT.unitary_normSq_one
statement: theorem unitary_normSq_one {z : ℂ} (h : z * (starRingEnd ℂ) z = 1) : normSq z = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h2 := congrArg Complex.re h
  rw [Complex.mul_conj] at h2
  simpa using h2

name: PDT.QM_from_Q
statement:
theorem QM_from_Q {a b : ℂ} (hnorm : normSq a + normSq b = 1) :
    (a * (starRingEnd ℂ) a).re = normSq a ∧
    (b * (starRingEnd ℂ) b).re = normSq b ∧
    0 ≤ normSq a ∧ 0 ≤ normSq b ∧
    normSq a + normSq b = 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨born_form a, born_form b, normSq_nonneg a, normSq_nonneg b, hnorm⟩

name: PDT.born_nonneg_physical
statement:
theorem born_nonneg_physical {H : Type*} [AddCommGroup H] [Module ℝ H]
    (P : QisHilbert H) (ψ : H) : 0 ≤ normSq (P ψ)
proof: := normSq_nonneg _

name: PdtStabilizer.actionMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma actionMap_apply (v : Fin N → ℚ) (X : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℚ) :
    actionMap v X = X *ᵥ v
proof: := rfl

name: PdtStabilizer.mem_sl
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_sl {X : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℚ} : X ∈ sl N ↔ X.trace = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [sl, LinearMap.mem_ker]

name: PdtStabilizer.slAction_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma slAction_apply (v : Fin N → ℚ) (X : sl N) :
    slAction v X = (X : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℚ) *ᵥ v
proof: := rfl

name: PdtStabilizer.colSolve_mulVec
statement: lemma colSolve_mulVec (hi : v i ≠ 0) : colSolve v w i *ᵥ v = w
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  simp only [colSolve, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.of_apply, ite_mul, zero_mul,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  exact div_mul_cancel₀ (w k) hi

name: PdtStabilizer.trace_colSolve
statement: lemma trace_colSolve : (colSolve v w i).trace = w i / v i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [colSolve, Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.of_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq',
    Finset.mem_univ, if_true]

name: PdtStabilizer.traceFixer_mulVec
statement: lemma traceFixer_mulVec (hi : v i ≠ 0) : traceFixer v i j *ᵥ v = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [traceFixer, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.single_mulVec, Matrix.single_mulVec, one_mul,
    div_mul_cancel₀ _ hi, sub_self]

name: PdtStabilizer.trace_traceFixer
statement: lemma trace_traceFixer (hij : j ≠ i) : (traceFixer v i j).trace = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [traceFixer, Matrix.trace_sub, Matrix.trace_single_eq_same,
    Matrix.trace_single_eq_of_ne _ _ _ hij, sub_zero]

name: PdtStabilizer.slSolve_mulVec
statement: lemma slSolve_mulVec (hi : v i ≠ 0) : slSolve v w i j *ᵥ v = w
proof:
:= by
  rw [slSolve, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, colSolve_mulVec v w i hi,
    traceFixer_mulVec v i j hi, smul_zero, sub_zero]

name: PdtStabilizer.trace_slSolve
statement: lemma trace_slSolve (hij : j ≠ i) : (slSolve v w i j).trace = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [slSolve, Matrix.trace_sub, Matrix.trace_smul, trace_colSolve,
    trace_traceFixer v i j hij, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, sub_self]

name: PdtStabilizer.actionMap_surjective
statement:
theorem actionMap_surjective {v : Fin N → ℚ} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    Function.Surjective (actionMap v)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hv
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hi
  intro w
  exact ⟨colSolve v w i, colSolve_mulVec v w i hi⟩

name: PdtStabilizer.slAction_surjective
statement:
theorem slAction_surjective (hN : 2 ≤ N) {v : Fin N → ℚ} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    Function.Surjective (slAction v)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hv
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hi
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Fintype.exists_ne_of_one_lt_card
    (by rw [Fintype.card_fin]; omega) i
  intro w
  refine ⟨⟨slSolve v w i j, mem_sl.mpr (trace_slSolve v w i j hj)⟩, ?_⟩
  simpa using slSolve_mulVec v w i j hi

name: PdtStabilizer.nat_sub₁
statement: private lemma nat_sub₁ (M K : ℕ) (h : 1 + K = M) : K = M - 1
proof: := by omega

name: PdtStabilizer.nat_sub₂
statement:
private lemma nat_sub₂ (M K n : ℕ) (hle : n + 1 ≤ M) (h : n + K = M - 1) :
    K = M - n - 1
proof: := by omega

name: PdtStabilizer.nat_sub₃
statement: private lemma nat_sub₃ (M K n : ℕ) (h : n + K = M) : K = M - n
proof: := by omega

name: PdtStabilizer.nat_sub₄
statement: private lemma nat_sub₄ (M n : ℕ) (h : n + 1 ≤ M) : M - n - 1 + 1 = M - n
proof: := by omega

name: PdtStabilizer.nat_sub₅
statement: private lemma nat_sub₅ (M n : ℕ) (h : n + 1 ≤ M) : M - 1 = n + (M - n - 1)
proof: := by omega

name: PdtStabilizer.aux_le
statement: lemma aux_le (hN : 2 ≤ N) : N + 1 ≤ N ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_two]
  calc N + 1 ≤ 2 * N := by omega
    _ ≤ N * N := Nat.mul_le_mul hN (le_refl N)

name: PdtStabilizer.finrank_gl
statement: lemma finrank_gl : finrank ℚ (Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℚ) = N * N
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.finrank_matrix]
  simp [Fintype.card_fin]

name: PdtStabilizer.traceLinearMap_surjective
statement:
lemma traceLinearMap_surjective (hN : 2 ≤ N) :
    Function.Surjective (Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin N) ℚ ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  intro c
  have hNe : (N : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
  refine ⟨(c / (N : ℚ)) • (1 : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℚ), ?_⟩
  rw [Matrix.traceLinearMap_apply, Matrix.trace_smul, Matrix.trace_one, Fintype.card_fin,
    smul_eq_mul]
  exact div_mul_cancel₀ c hNe

name: PdtStabilizer.finrank_sl
statement: theorem finrank_sl (hN : 2 ≤ N) : finrank ℚ (sl N) = N ^ 2 - 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin N) ℚ ℚ)
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (traceLinearMap_surjective hN), finrank_top,
    Module.finrank_self, finrank_gl] at h
  unfold sl
  rw [pow_two]
  exact nat_sub₁ (N * N) _ h

name: PdtStabilizer.finrank_stabilizer
statement:
theorem finrank_stabilizer (hN : 2 ≤ N) {v : Fin N → ℚ} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    finrank ℚ (stabilizer v) = N ^ 2 - N - 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (slAction v)
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (slAction_surjective hN hv), finrank_top,
    Module.finrank_pi, Fintype.card_fin, finrank_sl hN] at h
  unfold stabilizer
  exact nat_sub₂ (N ^ 2) _ N (aux_le hN) h

name: PdtStabilizer.finrank_glStabilizer
statement:
theorem finrank_glStabilizer {v : Fin N → ℚ} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    finrank ℚ (LinearMap.ker (actionMap v)) = N ^ 2 - N
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (actionMap v)
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (actionMap_surjective hv), finrank_top,
    Module.finrank_pi, Fintype.card_fin, finrank_gl] at h
  rw [pow_two]
  exact nat_sub₃ (N * N) _ N h

name: PdtStabilizer.stabilizer_corank_one
statement:
theorem stabilizer_corank_one (hN : 2 ≤ N) {v : Fin N → ℚ} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    finrank ℚ (stabilizer v) + 1 = finrank ℚ (LinearMap.ker (actionMap v))
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_stabilizer hN hv, finrank_glStabilizer hv]
  exact nat_sub₄ (N ^ 2) N (aux_le hN)

name: PdtStabilizer.exists_traceOne_mem_glStabilizer
statement:
theorem exists_traceOne_mem_glStabilizer (hN : 2 ≤ N) {v : Fin N → ℚ} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    ∃ Y ∈ LinearMap.ker (actionMap v), Matrix.trace Y = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hv
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hi
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Fintype.exists_ne_of_one_lt_card
    (by rw [Fintype.card_fin]; omega) i
  refine ⟨traceFixer v i j, ?_, trace_traceFixer v i j hj⟩
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, actionMap_apply]
  exact traceFixer_mulVec v i j hi

name: PdtStabilizer.stabilizer_map_subtype
statement:
theorem stabilizer_map_subtype (v : Fin N → ℚ) :
    (stabilizer v).map (sl N).subtype = sl N ⊓ LinearMap.ker (actionMap v)
proof:
:= by
  unfold stabilizer slAction
  rw [LinearMap.ker_comp, Submodule.map_comap_subtype]

name: PdtStabilizer.finrank_sl_eq_add
statement: theorem finrank_sl_eq_add (hN : 2 ≤ N) : finrank ℚ (sl N) = N + (N ^ 2 - N - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_sl hN]
  exact nat_sub₅ (N ^ 2) N (aux_le hN)

name: PdtStabilizer.finrank_stabilizer_four
statement:
theorem finrank_stabilizer_four {v : Fin 4 → ℚ} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    finrank ℚ (stabilizer v) = 11
proof:
:= by
  have h := finrank_stabilizer (by norm_num) hv
  norm_num at h
  exact h

name: PdtStabilizer.finrank_stabilizer_five
statement:
theorem finrank_stabilizer_five {v : Fin 5 → ℚ} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    finrank ℚ (stabilizer v) = 19
proof:
:= by
  have h := finrank_stabilizer (by norm_num) hv
  norm_num at h
  exact h

name: PdtStabilizer.finrank_stabilizer_fifteen
statement:
theorem finrank_stabilizer_fifteen {v : Fin 15 → ℚ} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    finrank ℚ (stabilizer v) = 209
proof:
:= by
  have h := finrank_stabilizer (by norm_num) hv
  norm_num at h
  exact h

name: PdtStabilizer.finrank_sl_four
statement: theorem finrank_sl_four : finrank ℚ (sl 4) = 15
proof:
:= by
  have h := finrank_sl (N := 4) (by norm_num)
  norm_num at h
  exact h

name: PDT.Mahler.q3_monic
statement: lemma q3_monic (a b c : ℂ) : (q3 a b c).Monic
proof:
:= by
  unfold q3; monicity!

name: PDT.Mahler.q3_natDegree
statement: lemma q3_natDegree (a b c : ℂ) : (q3 a b c).natDegree = 3
proof:
:= by
  unfold q3; compute_degree!

name: PDT.Mahler.q3_comp_neg
statement:
lemma q3_comp_neg (a b c : ℂ) :
    (q3 a b c).comp (-X) = -q3 (-a) b (-c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold q3
  simp only [add_comp, mul_comp, pow_comp, X_comp, C_comp, map_neg]
  ring

name: PDT.Mahler.q3_roots_card
statement:
lemma q3_roots_card (a b c : ℂ) :
    Multiset.card (q3 a b c).roots = 3
proof:
:= by
  have h := (IsAlgClosed.splits (k := ℂ) (q3 a b c)).natDegree_eq_card_roots
  rw [q3_natDegree] at h
  omega

name: PDT.Mahler.prod_X_add_C_roots3
statement:
lemma prod_X_add_C_roots3 (a b c : ℂ) :
    (((q3 a b c).roots).map fun r => X + C r).prod = q3 (-a) b (-c)
proof:
:= by
  have h := prod_X_sub_C_comp_neg (q3 a b c).roots
  rw [← monic_eq_prod_roots (q3_monic a b c), q3_comp_neg, q3_roots_card] at h
  have hodd : ((-1 : ℂ[X])) ^ (3 : ℕ) = -1 := by norm_num
  rw [hodd] at h
  have h2 : q3 (-a) b (-c)
      = ((q3 a b c).roots.map fun r => X - C (-r)).prod := by
    have := congrArg (fun p => -p) h
    simpa using this
  rw [h2]
  refine congrArg Multiset.prod (Multiset.map_congr rfl ?_)
  intro r _
  rw [map_neg, sub_neg_eq_add]

name: PDT.Mahler.gr3_ring
statement:
lemma gr3_ring (a b c : ℂ) :
    q3 a b c * q3 (-a) b (-c)
      = (q3 (2*b - a^2) (b^2 - 2*a*c) (-(c^2))).comp (X ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold q3
  simp only [add_comp, mul_comp, pow_comp, X_comp, C_comp]
  simp only [map_sub, map_add, map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_ofNat]
  ring

name: PDT.Mahler.mahlerMeasure_gr3
statement:
lemma mahlerMeasure_gr3 (a b c : ℂ) :
    (q3 (2*b - a^2) (b^2 - 2*a*c) (-(c^2))).mahlerMeasure
      = (q3 a b c).mahlerMeasure ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have key : q3 (2*b - a^2) (b^2 - 2*a*c) (-(c^2))
      = (((q3 a b c).roots.map fun r => r ^ 2).map fun r => X - C r).prod := by
    apply comp_X_sq_injective
    rw [multiset_prod_comp, Multiset.map_map, Multiset.map_map]
    simp only [Function.comp_def, sub_comp, X_comp, C_comp]
    rw [prod_X_sq_sub_sq, prod_X_add_C_roots3,
      ← monic_eq_prod_roots (q3_monic a b c), gr3_ring]
  rw [key, mahlerMeasure_multiset_prod_X_sub_C, Multiset.map_map,
    mahlerMeasure_eq_prod_roots (q3_monic a b c), pow_two,
    ← Multiset.prod_map_mul]
  refine congrArg Multiset.prod (Multiset.map_congr rfl ?_)
  intro r _
  exact max_one_norm_sq r

name: PDT.Mahler.map_zq3
statement:
lemma map_zq3 (t : Z3) :
    (zq3 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)
      = q3 (t.1 : ℂ) (t.2.1 : ℂ) (t.2.2 : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold zq3 q3
  simp [Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_pow, map_C]

name: PDT.Mahler.natDegree_map_zq3
statement:
lemma natDegree_map_zq3 (t : Z3) :
    ((zq3 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).natDegree = 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_zq3]; exact q3_natDegree _ _ _

name: PDT.Mahler.mahlerMeasure_map_gr3Z
statement:
lemma mahlerMeasure_map_gr3Z (t : Z3) :
    ((zq3 (gr3Z t)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
      = ((zq3 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, c⟩ := t
  rw [map_zq3, map_zq3]
  have harg : q3 ((gr3Z (a, b, c)).1 : ℂ) ((gr3Z (a, b, c)).2.1 : ℂ)
        ((gr3Z (a, b, c)).2.2 : ℂ)
      = q3 (2*(b:ℂ) - (a:ℂ)^2) ((b:ℂ)^2 - 2*(a:ℂ)*(c:ℂ)) (-((c:ℂ)^2)) := by
    show q3 ((2*b - a^2 : ℤ) : ℂ) ((b^2 - 2*a*c : ℤ) : ℂ)
        ((-(c^2) : ℤ) : ℂ) = _
    congr 1 <;> push_cast <;> ring
  rw [harg, mahlerMeasure_gr3]

name: PDT.Mahler.mahlerMeasure_map_gr3Z_iterate
statement:
lemma mahlerMeasure_map_gr3Z_iterate (K : ℕ) (t : Z3) :
    ((zq3 (gr3Z^[K] t)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
      = ((zq3 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure ^ (2 ^ K)
proof:
:= by
  induction K generalizing t with
  | zero => simp
  | succ K ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply, ih (gr3Z t), mahlerMeasure_map_gr3Z,
        ← pow_mul]
      congr 1
      ring

name: PDT.Mahler.coeff_map_zq3
statement:
lemma coeff_map_zq3 (t : Z3) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ 3) :
    ((zq3 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).coeff k = (tupCoeff3 t k : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, c⟩ := t
  rw [map_zq3]
  interval_cases k <;> simp [q3, tupCoeff3, coeff_int_cast_CX]

name: PDT.Mahler.lower_cert3_sound
statement:
lemma lower_cert3_sound {t : Z3} {P Q : ℕ} (hQ : 0 < Q) {K k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ 3)
    (h : (Nat.choose 3 k : ℤ) * (P : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ K)
        < |tupCoeff3 (gr3Z^[K] t) k| * (Q : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ K)) :
    (P : ℝ) / Q < ((zq3 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
proof:
:= by
  set M : ℝ := ((zq3 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure with hM
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := mahlerMeasure_nonneg _
  have hchoose : (0 : ℝ) < (Nat.choose 3 k : ℝ) :=
    Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.choose_pos hk)
  have hQ0 : (0 : ℝ) < (Q : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K) := by positivity
  have hbound := norm_coeff_le_choose_mul_mahlerMeasure k
      ((zq3 (gr3Z^[K] t)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ))
  rw [natDegree_map_zq3, mahlerMeasure_map_gr3Z_iterate,
    coeff_map_zq3 _ _ hk] at hbound
  simp only [Complex.norm_intCast] at hbound
  rw [← hM] at hbound
  have hR : (Nat.choose 3 k : ℝ) * (P : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K)
      < |((tupCoeff3 (gr3Z^[K] t) k : ℤ) : ℝ)| * (Q : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K) := by
    exact_mod_cast h
  have step1 : (Nat.choose 3 k : ℝ) * (P : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K)
      < (Nat.choose 3 k : ℝ) * (M ^ (2 ^ K) * (Q : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K)) :=
    calc (Nat.choose 3 k : ℝ) * (P : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K)
        < |((tupCoeff3 (gr3Z^[K] t) k : ℤ) : ℝ)| * (Q : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K) := hR
      _ ≤ (Nat.choose 3 k : ℝ) * M ^ (2 ^ K) * (Q : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbound (le_of_lt hQ0)
      _ = (Nat.choose 3 k : ℝ) * (M ^ (2 ^ K) * (Q : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K)) := by ring
  have hpow : ((P : ℝ) / Q) ^ (2 ^ K) < M ^ (2 ^ K) := by
    rw [div_pow, div_lt_iff₀ hQ0]
    exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left step1 (le_of_lt hchoose)
  exact lt_of_pow_lt_pow_left₀ _ hM0 hpow

name: PDT.Mahler.mahlerMeasure_map_zq3_le_l1
statement:
lemma mahlerMeasure_map_zq3_le_l1 (s : Z3) :
    ((zq3 s).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure ≤ (tupL1_3 s : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  refine (mahlerMeasure_le_sum_norm_coeff _).trans ?_
  rw [Polynomial.sum_def]
  have hsupp : ((zq3 s).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).support ⊆ Finset.range 4 := by
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.mem_range]
    have h1 := Polynomial.le_natDegree_of_mem_supp n hn
    rw [natDegree_map_zq3] at h1
    omega
  refine (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsupp
    (fun i _ _ => norm_nonneg _)).trans ?_
  rw [show (4 : ℕ) = 3 + 1 from rfl, Finset.sum_range_succ,
    Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_one]
  rw [coeff_map_zq3 _ 0 (by norm_num), coeff_map_zq3 _ 1 (by norm_num),
    coeff_map_zq3 _ 2 (by norm_num), coeff_map_zq3 _ 3 (by norm_num)]
  obtain ⟨a, b, c⟩ := s
  simp only [tupCoeff3, tupL1_3, Complex.norm_intCast]
  push_cast
  rw [abs_one]
  linarith [abs_nonneg (a : ℝ), abs_nonneg (b : ℝ), abs_nonneg (c : ℝ)]

name: PDT.Mahler.upper_cert3_sound
proof:
:= by
  set M : ℝ := ((zq3 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure with hM
  have hQ0 : (0 : ℝ) < (Q : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K) := by positivity
  have hl1 := mahlerMeasure_map_zq3_le_l1 (gr3Z^[K] t)
  rw [mahlerMeasure_map_gr3Z_iterate, ← hM] at hl1
  have hR : (tupL1_3 (gr3Z^[K] t) : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K)
      ≤ (P : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K) := by exact_mod_cast h
  have hpow : M ^ (2 ^ K) ≤ ((P : ℝ) / Q) ^ (2 ^ K) := by
    rw [div_pow, le_div_iff₀ hQ0]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hl1 (le_of_lt hQ0)).trans hR
  exact le_of_pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (by positivity) hpow

name: PDT.Mahler.lowerHit3_sound
proof:
:= by
  unfold lowerHit3 at h
  simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
  rcases h with (h | h) | h
  · have hc : ((Nat.choose 3 0 : ℕ) : ℤ) = 1 := by norm_num
    exact lower_cert3_sound (K := K) (k := 0) hQ (by norm_num)
      (by rw [hc]; exact h)
  · have hc : ((Nat.choose 3 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = 3 := by norm_num
    exact lower_cert3_sound (K := K) (k := 1) hQ (by norm_num)
      (by rw [hc]; exact h)
  · have hc : ((Nat.choose 3 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) = 3 := by norm_num [Nat.choose]
    exact lower_cert3_sound (K := K) (k := 2) hQ (by norm_num)
      (by rw [hc]; exact h)

name: PDT.Mahler.lowerCert3_sound
statement:
lemma lowerCert3_sound {P Q : ℕ} (hQ : 0 < Q) :
    ∀ (fuel K : ℕ) (t : Z3),
      lowerCert3 fuel ((P : ℤ) ^ 2 ^ K) ((Q : ℤ) ^ 2 ^ K) (gr3Z^[K] t) = true →
      (P : ℝ) / Q < ((zq3 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
proof:
:= by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero => intro K t h; simp [lowerCert3] at h
  | succ fuel ih =>
      intro K t h
      unfold lowerCert3 at h
      simp only [Bool.or_eq_true] at h
      rcases h with h1 | h2
      · exact lowerHit3_sound hQ h1
      · have e1 : ((P : ℤ) ^ 2 ^ K) ^ 2 = (P : ℤ) ^ 2 ^ (K + 1) := by
          rw [← pow_mul, pow_succ]
        have e2 : ((Q : ℤ) ^ 2 ^ K) ^ 2 = (Q : ℤ) ^ 2 ^ (K + 1) := by
          rw [← pow_mul, pow_succ]
        have e3 : gr3Z (gr3Z^[K] t) = gr3Z^[K + 1] t :=
          (Function.iterate_succ_apply' gr3Z K t).symm
        rw [e1, e2, e3] at h2
        exact ih (K + 1) t h2

name: PDT.Mahler.lowerCert3_133_sound
statement:
lemma lowerCert3_133_sound {t : Z3} (h : lowerCert3 9 133 100 t = true) :
    (133 : ℝ) / 100 < ((zq3 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
proof:
:= by
  have hs := lowerCert3_sound (P := 133) (Q := 100) (by norm_num) 9 0 t
  simp only [pow_zero, pow_one, Function.iterate_zero_apply] at hs
  have h' : lowerCert3 9 ((133 : ℕ) : ℤ) ((100 : ℕ) : ℤ) t = true := by
    exact_mod_cast h
  exact_mod_cast hs h'

name: PDT.Mahler.boxD3_all
statement: theorem boxD3_all : ∀ t ∈ boxD3, elemOK3 t = true
proof: := by decide

name: PDT.Mahler.zq3_monic_int
statement: lemma zq3_monic_int (t : Z3) : (zq3 t).Monic
proof:
:= by
  unfold zq3; monicity!

name: PDT.Mahler.zq3_natDegree_int
statement: lemma zq3_natDegree_int (t : Z3) : (zq3 t).natDegree = 3
proof:
:= by
  unfold zq3; compute_degree!

name: PDT.Mahler.coeff_zq3
statement:
lemma coeff_zq3 (t : Z3) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ 3) :
    (zq3 t).coeff k = tupCoeff3 t k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, c⟩ := t
  interval_cases k <;> simp [zq3, tupCoeff3, coeff_int_cast_ZX]

name: PDT.Mahler.eq_zq3_self
statement:
lemma eq_zq3_self (p : ℤ[X]) (hm : p.Monic) (hd : p.natDegree = 3) :
    p = zq3 (p.coeff 2, p.coeff 1, p.coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  by_cases hn : n ≤ 3
  · interval_cases n
    · rw [coeff_zq3 _ 0 (by norm_num)]; rfl
    · rw [coeff_zq3 _ 1 (by norm_num)]; rfl
    · rw [coeff_zq3 _ 2 (by norm_num)]; rfl
    · rw [coeff_zq3 _ 3 (by norm_num)]
      show p.coeff 3 = 1
      have := hm.coeff_natDegree
      rwa [hd] at this
  · push_neg at hn
    rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by rw [hd]; omega),
      coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by rw [zq3_natDegree_int]; omega)]

name: PDT.Mahler.zq3_mul12
statement:
lemma zq3_mul12 (u : ℤ) (v : ℤ × ℤ) :
    zq3 (mul12 u v) = zlin u * zquad' v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v1, v0⟩ := v
  unfold zq3 mul12 zlin zquad'
  simp only [map_add, map_mul]
  ring

name: PDT.Mahler.zquad'_natDegree
statement: lemma zquad'_natDegree (v : ℤ × ℤ) : (zquad' v).natDegree = 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold zquad'; compute_degree!

name: PDT.Mahler.not_irr_mul12
statement:
lemma not_irr_mul12 (u : ℤ) (v : ℤ × ℤ) :
    ¬ Irreducible (zq3 (mul12 u v))
proof:
:= by
  rw [zq3_mul12]
  intro hi
  rcases hi.isUnit_or_isUnit rfl with h | h
  · exact Polynomial.not_isUnit_of_natDegree_pos _
      (by rw [zlin_natDegree]; norm_num) h
  · exact Polynomial.not_isUnit_of_natDegree_pos _
      (by rw [zquad'_natDegree]; norm_num) h

name: PDT.Mahler.tie3_neg_eq
statement:
lemma tie3_neg_eq :
    ((zq3 (0, -1, 1)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
      = ((zq3 (0, -1, -1)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_zq3, map_zq3]
  push_cast
  have h := mahlerMeasure_comp_neg (q3_monic 0 (-1) (-1))
  rw [q3_comp_neg] at h
  have hneg : (-(q3 (-0) (-1) (-(-1)))).mahlerMeasure
      = (q3 (-0) (-1) (-(-1))).mahlerMeasure := by
    rw [show (-(q3 (-0) (-1) (-(-1)))) = C (-1) * q3 (-0) (-1) (-(-1)) by
        rw [map_neg, map_one, neg_one_mul],
      mahlerMeasure_mul, mahlerMeasure_const]
    simp
  rw [hneg] at h
  norm_num at h ⊢
  exact h

name: PDT.Mahler.q3_prod_roots
statement: lemma q3_prod_roots (a b c : ℂ) : (q3 a b c).roots.prod = -c
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (eval 0) (monic_eq_prod_roots (q3_monic a b c))
  rw [eval_multiset_prod, Multiset.map_map] at h
  have h2 : eval 0 (q3 a b c) = c := by simp [q3]
  have h3 : ((q3 a b c).roots.map (eval 0 ∘ fun r => X - C r))
      = (q3 a b c).roots.map fun r => -(id r) := by
    refine Multiset.map_congr rfl ?_
    intro r _
    simp
  rw [h2, h3, prod_map_neg', q3_roots_card] at h
  simp only [id] at h
  norm_num at h
  linear_combination h

name: PDT.Mahler.prod_roots_inv3
statement:
lemma prod_roots_inv3 (a b c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    ((q3 a b c).roots.map fun r => X - C r⁻¹).prod
      = q3 (b/c) (a/c) (1/c)
proof:
:= by
  have hprodr : (q3 a b c).roots.prod = -c := q3_prod_roots a b c
  have hroots0 : ∀ r ∈ (q3 a b c).roots, r ≠ 0 := by
    intro r hr h0
    subst h0
    have h := isRoot_of_mem_roots hr
    simp [q3, IsRoot] at h
    exact hc h
  apply Polynomial.funext
  intro y
  rw [eval_multiset_prod, Multiset.map_map]
  have hinv : ((q3 a b c).roots.map fun r => r⁻¹).prod = -c⁻¹ := by
    rw [Multiset.prod_map_inv]
    simp [hprodr]
  by_cases hy : y = 0
  · subst hy
    have hmap : ((q3 a b c).roots.map (eval 0 ∘ fun r => X - C r⁻¹))
        = (q3 a b c).roots.map fun r => -(fun r : ℂ => r⁻¹) r := by
      refine Multiset.map_congr rfl ?_
      intro r _
      simp
    rw [hmap, prod_map_neg' _ (fun r => r⁻¹), q3_roots_card, hinv]
    simp only [q3, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_X, eval_C]
    ring
  · have hstep : ((q3 a b c).roots.map
          (eval y ∘ fun r => X - C r⁻¹)).prod
        = ((q3 a b c).roots.map fun r => r⁻¹ * (r * y - 1)).prod := by
      refine congrArg Multiset.prod (Multiset.map_congr rfl ?_)
      intro r hr
      have hr0 := hroots0 r hr
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]
      field_simp
    have hsplit : ((q3 a b c).roots.map fun r => r⁻¹ * (r * y - 1)).prod
        = ((q3 a b c).roots.map fun r => r⁻¹).prod
          * ((q3 a b c).roots.map fun r => r * y - 1).prod := by
      rw [← Multiset.prod_map_mul]
    have hfactor : ((q3 a b c).roots.map fun r => r * y - 1)
        = (q3 a b c).roots.map fun r => y * (r - y⁻¹) := by
      refine Multiset.map_congr rfl ?_
      intro r _
      field_simp
    have hconst : ((q3 a b c).roots.map fun _ => y).prod = y ^ 3 := by
      rw [Multiset.map_const', Multiset.prod_replicate, q3_roots_card]
    have hshift : ((q3 a b c).roots.map fun r => r - y⁻¹).prod
        = -eval y⁻¹ (q3 a b c) := by
      have hs : ((q3 a b c).roots.map fun r => r - y⁻¹)
          = (q3 a b c).roots.map fun r => -(fun r : ℂ => y⁻¹ - r) r := by
        refine Multiset.map_congr rfl ?_
        intro r _
        ring_nf
      rw [hs, prod_map_neg' _ (fun r => y⁻¹ - r), q3_roots_card]
      have h3 : ((-1 : ℂ)) ^ (3:ℕ) = -1 := by norm_num
      rw [h3]
      have heval : ((q3 a b c).roots.map fun r => y⁻¹ - r).prod
          = eval y⁻¹ (q3 a b c) := by
        conv_rhs => rw [monic_eq_prod_roots (q3_monic a b c)]
        rw [eval_multiset_prod, Multiset.map_map]
        refine congrArg Multiset.prod (Multiset.map_congr rfl ?_)
        intro r _
        simp
      rw [heval]
      ring
    have hG : ((q3 a b c).roots.map fun r => r * y - 1).prod
        = -(y ^ 3 * eval y⁻¹ (q3 a b c)) := by
      rw [hfactor]
      have hmul : ((q3 a b c).roots.map fun r => y * (r - y⁻¹)).prod
          = ((q3 a b c).roots.map fun _ => y).prod
            * ((q3 a b c).roots.map fun r => r - y⁻¹).prod := by
        rw [← Multiset.prod_map_mul]
      rw [hmul, hconst, hshift]
      ring
    rw [hstep, hsplit, hinv, hG]
    simp only [q3, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_X, eval_C]
    field_simp
    ring

name: PDT.Mahler.mahlerMeasure_q3_inv
statement:
lemma mahlerMeasure_q3_inv (a b c : ℂ) (hc : ‖c‖ = 1) :
    (q3 (b/c) (a/c) (1/c)).mahlerMeasure = (q3 a b c).mahlerMeasure
proof:
:= by
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hc
    simp at hc
  have hroots0 : ∀ r ∈ (q3 a b c).roots, r ≠ 0 := by
    intro r hr h0
    subst h0
    have h := isRoot_of_mem_roots hr
    simp [q3, IsRoot] at h
    exact hc0 h
  have hmap : ((q3 a b c).roots.map fun r => X - C r⁻¹)
      = Multiset.map (fun r => X - C r) ((q3 a b c).roots.map fun r => r⁻¹) := by
    rw [Multiset.map_map]
    rfl
  rw [← prod_roots_inv3 a b c hc0, hmap, mahlerMeasure_multiset_prod_X_sub_C,
    Multiset.map_map, mahlerMeasure_eq_prod_roots (q3_monic a b c)]
  have hpt : ((q3 a b c).roots.map
        ((fun r => max 1 ‖r‖) ∘ fun r => r⁻¹))
      = (q3 a b c).roots.map fun r => max 1 ‖r‖ / ‖r‖ := by
    refine Multiset.map_congr rfl ?_
    intro r hr
    exact max_one_norm_inv (hroots0 r hr)
  rw [hpt]
  have hdiv : ((q3 a b c).roots.map fun r => max 1 ‖r‖ / ‖r‖).prod
      = ((q3 a b c).roots.map fun r => max 1 ‖r‖).prod
        / ((q3 a b c).roots.map fun r => ‖r‖).prod := by
    rw [← Multiset.prod_map_div]
  have hprodr : (q3 a b c).roots.prod = -c := q3_prod_roots a b c
  have hnorm : ((q3 a b c).roots.map fun r => ‖r‖).prod = 1 := by
    rw [← norm_prod_multiset, hprodr, norm_neg, hc]
  rw [hdiv, hnorm, div_one]

name: PDT.Mahler.tie3_rev_eq
statement:
lemma tie3_rev_eq :
    ((zq3 (1, 0, -1)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
      = ((zq3 (0, -1, -1)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_zq3, map_zq3]
  push_cast
  have h := mahlerMeasure_q3_inv 0 (-1) (-1) (by norm_num)
  norm_num at h ⊢
  exact h

name: PDT.Mahler.tie3_revneg_eq
statement:
lemma tie3_revneg_eq :
    ((zq3 (-1, 0, 1)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
      = ((zq3 (0, -1, -1)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ((zq3 (-1, 0, 1)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
      = ((zq3 (0, -1, 1)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure := by
    rw [map_zq3, map_zq3]
    push_cast
    have h := mahlerMeasure_q3_inv 0 (-1) 1 (by norm_num)
    norm_num at h ⊢
    exact h
  rw [h1, tie3_neg_eq]

name: PDT.Mahler.fam3_upper
statement:
lemma fam3_upper :
    ((zq3 (0, -1, -1)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
      ≤ (133 : ℝ) / 100
proof:
:= by
  have h := upper_cert3_sound (t := (0, -1, -1)) (P := 133) (Q := 100)
    (by norm_num) (K := 5) (by decide)
  exact_mod_cast h

name: PDT.Mahler.mem_boxD3
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, c⟩ := t
  simp [boxD3, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc, abs_le]

name: PDT.Mahler.lowerCert3_succ_def
statement:
lemma lowerCert3_succ_def (fuel : ℕ) (P2 Q2 : ℤ) (s : Z3) :
    lowerCert3 (fuel + 1) P2 Q2 s
      = (lowerHit3 P2 Q2 s || lowerCert3 fuel (P2 ^ 2) (Q2 ^ 2) (gr3Z s))
proof: := rfl

name: PDT.Mahler.lowerCert3_of_not_mem
statement:
lemma lowerCert3_of_not_mem {t : Z3} (h : t ∉ boxD3) :
    lowerCert3 9 133 100 t = true
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, c⟩ := t
  rw [mem_boxD3] at h
  have hd : 3 < |a| ∨ 3 < |b| ∨ 1 < |c| := by
    by_contra hc'
    push_neg at hc'
    exact h ⟨hc'.1, hc'.2.1, hc'.2.2⟩
  rw [lowerCert3_succ_def, Bool.or_eq_true]
  left
  unfold lowerHit3
  simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
  rcases hd with h3 | h3b | h1c
  · right
    show 3 * 133 < |tupCoeff3 (a, b, c) 2| * 100
    have : tupCoeff3 (a, b, c) 2 = a := rfl
    rw [this]
    generalize |a| = m at h3 ⊢
    omega
  · left; right
    show 3 * 133 < |tupCoeff3 (a, b, c) 1| * 100
    have : tupCoeff3 (a, b, c) 1 = b := rfl
    rw [this]
    generalize |b| = m at h3b ⊢
    omega
  · left; left
    show 1 * 133 < |tupCoeff3 (a, b, c) 0| * 100
    have : tupCoeff3 (a, b, c) 0 = c := rfl
    rw [this]
    generalize |c| = m at h1c ⊢
    omega

name: PDT.Mahler.cubic_mahler_min
statement:
theorem cubic_mahler_min (p : ℤ[X]) (hm : p.Monic) (hd : p.natDegree = 3)
    (hi : Irreducible p)
    (h1 : 1 < (p.map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure) :
    ((zq3 (0, -1, -1)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
      ≤ (p.map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
proof:
:= by
  have hp : p = zq3 (p.coeff 2, p.coeff 1, p.coeff 0) := eq_zq3_self p hm hd
  set t : Z3 := (p.coeff 2, p.coeff 1, p.coeff 0) with ht
  rw [hp] at h1 hi ⊢
  by_cases hbox : t ∈ boxD3
  · have hOK := boxD3_all t hbox
    unfold elemOK3 at hOK
    simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, List.any_eq_true] at hOK
    rcases hOK with ((htie | hf12) | hcert)
    · simp only [tieList3, List.mem_cons, List.mem_singleton] at htie
      rcases htie with h | h | h | (h | hfalse)
      · rw [h]
      · rw [h, tie3_neg_eq]
      · rw [h, tie3_rev_eq]
      · rw [h, tie3_revneg_eq]
      · simp at hfalse
    · obtain ⟨pr, _, heq⟩ := hf12
      rw [← heq] at hi
      exact absurd hi (not_irr_mul12 pr.1 pr.2)
    · exact fam3_upper.trans (le_of_lt (lowerCert3_133_sound hcert))
  · exact fam3_upper.trans
      (le_of_lt (lowerCert3_133_sound (lowerCert3_of_not_mem hbox)))

name: PDT.Mahler.rho_real_root_cases
statement:
lemma rho_real_root_cases (x : ℝ) (hx : x ^ 3 = x + 1) :
    33/25 < x ∧ x < 3/2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · by_contra hle
    push_neg at hle
    rcases le_or_gt x (-1) with h | h
    · nlinarith [hx, mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg
        (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ -x) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - x))
        (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ -1 - x)]
    · rcases le_or_gt x 0 with h0 | h0
      · nlinarith [hx, (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < x + 1),
          mul_nonneg (neg_nonneg.2 h0) (mul_self_nonneg x)]
      · rcases le_or_gt x 1 with h1 | h1
        · nlinarith [hx, mul_nonneg h0.le (by nlinarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - x^2)]
        · have hsq : x^2 ≤ (33/25)^2 := by nlinarith
          nlinarith [hx, mul_le_mul hle hsq (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
  · by_contra hle
    push_neg at hle
    have hsq : (3/2:ℝ)^2 ≤ x^2 := by nlinarith
    nlinarith [hx, mul_le_mul hle hsq (by positivity) (by linarith)]

name: PDT.Mahler.rho_real_root_unique
statement:
lemma rho_real_root_unique {x y : ℝ} (hx : x ^ 3 = x + 1) (h1x : 1 < x)
    (hy : y ^ 3 = y + 1) (h1y : 1 < y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
  · nlinarith [hx, hy, mul_pos (sub_pos.2 h)
      (by nlinarith : (0:ℝ) < y^2 + y*x + x^2 - 1)]
  · nlinarith [hx, hy, mul_pos (sub_pos.2 h)
      (by nlinarith : (0:ℝ) < x^2 + x*y + y^2 - 1)]

name: PDT.Mahler.fam3_lower_11
statement:
lemma fam3_lower_11 :
    (11 : ℝ) / 10
      < ((zq3 (0, -1, -1)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
proof:
:= by
  have hs := lowerCert3_sound (P := 11) (Q := 10) (by norm_num) 9 0 (0, -1, -1)
  simp only [pow_zero, pow_one, Function.iterate_zero_apply] at hs
  have h' : lowerCert3 9 ((11 : ℕ) : ℤ) ((10 : ℕ) : ℤ) (0, -1, -1) = true := by
    exact_mod_cast (by decide : lowerCert3 9 (11 : ℤ) (10 : ℤ) (0, -1, -1) = true)
  exact_mod_cast hs h'

name: PDT.Mahler.mahler_cubic_rho
statement:
theorem mahler_cubic_rho :
    (((zq3 (0, -1, -1)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure) ^ 3
        = ((zq3 (0, -1, -1)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure + 1
      ∧ 1 < ((zq3 (0, -1, -1)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
proof:
:= by
  have hswitch : ((zq3 (0, -1, -1)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)) = q3 0 (-1) (-1) := by
    rw [map_zq3]
    norm_num
  rw [hswitch]
  set G : ℂ[X] := q3 0 (-1) (-1) with hG
  have hroot_eq : ∀ r ∈ G.roots, r ^ 3 = r + 1 := by
    intro r hr
    have h := isRoot_of_mem_roots hr
    simp only [hG, IsRoot, q3, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_X, eval_C,
      map_neg, map_one, eval_neg, eval_one] at h
    linear_combination h
  have hMup : G.mahlerMeasure ≤ 133/100 := by
    rw [← hswitch]
    exact_mod_cast fam3_upper
  have hMlow : 11/10 < G.mahlerMeasure := by
    rw [← hswitch]
    exact_mod_cast fam3_lower_11
  have hMform : G.mahlerMeasure = (G.roots.map fun r => max 1 ‖r‖).prod :=
    mahlerMeasure_eq_prod_roots (q3_monic _ _ _)
  have hexists : ∃ r ∈ G.roots, 1 < ‖r‖ := by
    by_contra hall
    push_neg at hall
    have hone : ∀ r ∈ G.roots, max 1 ‖r‖ = 1 := fun r hr =>
      max_eq_left (hall r hr)
    rw [hMform, Multiset.map_congr rfl hone] at hMlow
    simp at hMlow
    linarith
  obtain ⟨rstar, hrmem, hrbig⟩ := hexists
  have hrim : rstar.im = 0 := by
    by_contra him
    exact absurd (PDT.cubic_conj_norm_lt_one rstar (hroot_eq rstar hrmem) him)
      (not_lt.mpr hrbig.le)
  have hrre : rstar = ((rstar.re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hrim]
  set x : ℝ := rstar.re with hxdef
  have hxroot : x ^ 3 = x + 1 := by
    have h := hroot_eq rstar hrmem
    rw [hrre] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  have hxcases := rho_real_root_cases x hxroot
  have hx1 : 1 < x := by linarith [hxcases.1]
  have hxpos : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hnormx : ‖rstar‖ = x := by
    have h1 : ‖rstar‖ = |x| := by rw [hrre]; exact Complex.norm_real _
    rw [h1, abs_of_pos hxpos]
  have hcount : Multiset.count rstar G.roots = 1 := by
    have hge : 1 ≤ Multiset.count rstar G.roots :=
      Multiset.one_le_count_iff_mem.mpr hrmem
    by_contra hne
    have h2 : 2 ≤ Multiset.count rstar G.roots := by omega
    have hrep : Multiset.replicate 2 rstar ≤ G.roots :=
      Multiset.le_count_iff_replicate_le.mp h2
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Multiset.le_iff_exists_add.mp hrep
    have hform2 : (G.roots.map fun r => max 1 ‖r‖).prod
        = (max 1 ‖rstar‖) ^ 2 * (u.map fun r => max 1 ‖r‖).prod := by
      rw [hu, Multiset.map_add, Multiset.prod_add, Multiset.map_replicate,
        Multiset.prod_replicate]
    rw [hform2] at hMform
    have hsq : (max 1 ‖rstar‖) ^ 2 = x ^ 2 := by
      rw [hnormx, max_eq_right hx1.le]
    rw [hsq] at hMform
    have hx2 : (33/25 : ℝ)^2 < x ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hxcases.1]
    nlinarith [hMform, hMup, one_le_prod_max u, hx2]
  have herase : ∀ r ∈ G.roots.erase rstar, max 1 ‖r‖ = 1 := by
    intro r hr
    have hrmem' : r ∈ G.roots := Multiset.mem_of_mem_erase hr
    have hrne : r ≠ rstar := by
      intro h
      subst h
      have hcz : Multiset.count r (G.roots.erase r) = 0 := by
        simp [Multiset.count_erase_self, hcount]
      exact absurd hr (Multiset.count_eq_zero.mp hcz)
    apply max_eq_left
    by_cases him : r.im = 0
    · have hre : r = ((r.re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by apply Complex.ext <;> simp [him]
      have hroot' : r.re ^ 3 = r.re + 1 := by
        have h := hroot_eq r hrmem'
        rw [hre] at h
        exact_mod_cast h
      exfalso
      apply hrne
      rw [hre, hrre]
      norm_cast
      exact rho_real_root_unique hroot'
        (by linarith [(rho_real_root_cases _ hroot').1]) hxroot hx1
    · exact (PDT.cubic_conj_norm_lt_one r (hroot_eq r hrmem') him).le
  have hMx : G.mahlerMeasure = x := by
    rw [hMform, ← Multiset.prod_map_erase (f := fun r => max 1 ‖r‖) hrmem]
    rw [Multiset.map_congr rfl herase]
    simp [hnormx, max_eq_right hx1.le]
  constructor
  · rw [hMx]; exact hxroot
  · rw [hMx]; exact hx1

theorem cubic_mahler_min' (p : ℤ[X]) (hm : p.Monic) (hd : p.natDegree = 3)

      ≤ (p.map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure

name: PDT.Mahler.prod_X_add_C_roots2
statement:
lemma prod_X_add_C_roots2 (a b : ℂ) :
    (((q2 a b).roots).map fun r => X + C r).prod = q2 (-a) b
proof:
:= by
  have h := prod_X_sub_C_comp_neg (q2 a b).roots
  rw [← monic_eq_prod_roots (q2_monic a b), q2_comp_neg, q2_roots_card,
    Even.neg_one_pow (by decide : Even 2), one_mul] at h
  rw [h]

  rw [map_neg, sub_neg_eq_add]

name: PDT.Mahler.gr2_ring
statement:
lemma gr2_ring (a b : ℂ) :
    q2 a b * q2 (-a) b = (q2 (2*b - a^2) (b^2)).comp (X ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold q2

name: PDT.Mahler.mahlerMeasure_gr2
statement:
lemma mahlerMeasure_gr2 (a b : ℂ) :
    (q2 (2*b - a^2) (b^2)).mahlerMeasure = (q2 a b).mahlerMeasure ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have key : q2 (2*b - a^2) (b^2)
      = (((q2 a b).roots.map fun r => r ^ 2).map fun r => X - C r).prod := by
    apply comp_X_sq_injective
    rw [multiset_prod_comp, Multiset.map_map, Multiset.map_map]
    simp only [Function.comp_def, sub_comp, X_comp, C_comp]
    rw [prod_X_sq_sub_sq, prod_X_add_C_roots2,
      ← monic_eq_prod_roots (q2_monic a b), gr2_ring]
  rw [key, mahlerMeasure_multiset_prod_X_sub_C, Multiset.map_map,
    mahlerMeasure_eq_prod_roots (q2_monic a b), pow_two,
    ← Multiset.prod_map_mul]
  refine congrArg Multiset.prod (Multiset.map_congr rfl ?_)
  intro r _
  exact max_one_norm_sq r

name: PDT.Mahler.map_zq2

    (zq2 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ) = q2 (t.1 : ℂ) (t.2 : ℂ)
proof:

  simp [Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_pow, map_C]

name: PDT.Mahler.natDegree_map_zq2

proof:

  rw [map_zq2]; exact q2_natDegree _ _

name: PDT.Mahler.mahlerMeasure_map_gr2Z
statement:
lemma mahlerMeasure_map_gr2Z (t : Z2) :
    ((zq2 (gr2Z t)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
      = ((zq2 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := t
  rw [map_zq2, map_zq2]
  have harg : q2 ((gr2Z (a, b)).1 : ℂ) ((gr2Z (a, b)).2 : ℂ)
      = q2 (2*(b:ℂ) - (a:ℂ)^2) ((b:ℂ)^2) := by
    show q2 ((2*b - a^2 : ℤ) : ℂ) ((b^2 : ℤ) : ℂ) = _
    congr 1 <;> push_cast <;> ring
  rw [harg, mahlerMeasure_gr2]

name: PDT.Mahler.mahlerMeasure_map_gr2Z_iterate
statement:
lemma mahlerMeasure_map_gr2Z_iterate (K : ℕ) (t : Z2) :
    ((zq2 (gr2Z^[K] t)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
      = ((zq2 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure ^ (2 ^ K)
proof:
:= by
  induction K generalizing t with
  | zero => simp
  | succ K ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply, ih (gr2Z t), mahlerMeasure_map_gr2Z,
        ← pow_mul]
      congr 1
      ring

name: PDT.Mahler.coeff_map_zq2
statement:
lemma coeff_map_zq2 (t : Z2) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ 2) :
    ((zq2 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).coeff k = (tupCoeff2 t k : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := t
  rw [map_zq2]
  interval_cases k <;> simp [q2, tupCoeff2, coeff_int_cast_CX]

name: PDT.Mahler.lower_cert2_sound
statement:
lemma lower_cert2_sound {t : Z2} {P Q : ℕ} (hQ : 0 < Q) {K k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ 2)
    (h : (Nat.choose 2 k : ℤ) * (P : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ K)
        < |tupCoeff2 (gr2Z^[K] t) k| * (Q : ℤ) ^ (2 ^ K)) :
    (P : ℝ) / Q < ((zq2 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
proof:
:= by
  set M : ℝ := ((zq2 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure with hM
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := mahlerMeasure_nonneg _
  have hchoose : (0 : ℝ) < (Nat.choose 2 k : ℝ) :=
    Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.choose_pos hk)
  have hQ0 : (0 : ℝ) < (Q : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K) := by positivity
  have hbound := norm_coeff_le_choose_mul_mahlerMeasure k
      ((zq2 (gr2Z^[K] t)).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ))
  rw [natDegree_map_zq2, mahlerMeasure_map_gr2Z_iterate,
    coeff_map_zq2 _ _ hk] at hbound
  simp only [Complex.norm_intCast] at hbound
  rw [← hM] at hbound
  have hR : (Nat.choose 2 k : ℝ) * (P : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K)
      < |((tupCoeff2 (gr2Z^[K] t) k : ℤ) : ℝ)| * (Q : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K) := by
    exact_mod_cast h
  have step1 : (Nat.choose 2 k : ℝ) * (P : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K)
      < (Nat.choose 2 k : ℝ) * (M ^ (2 ^ K) * (Q : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K)) :=
    calc (Nat.choose 2 k : ℝ) * (P : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K)
        < |((tupCoeff2 (gr2Z^[K] t) k : ℤ) : ℝ)| * (Q : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K) := hR
      _ ≤ (Nat.choose 2 k : ℝ) * M ^ (2 ^ K) * (Q : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbound (le_of_lt hQ0)
      _ = (Nat.choose 2 k : ℝ) * (M ^ (2 ^ K) * (Q : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K)) := by ring
  have hpow : ((P : ℝ) / Q) ^ (2 ^ K) < M ^ (2 ^ K) := by
    rw [div_pow, div_lt_iff₀ hQ0]
    exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left step1 (le_of_lt hchoose)
  exact lt_of_pow_lt_pow_left₀ _ hM0 hpow

name: PDT.Mahler.mahlerMeasure_map_zq2_le_l1
statement:
lemma mahlerMeasure_map_zq2_le_l1 (s : Z2) :
    ((zq2 s).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure ≤ (tupL1_2 s : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  refine (mahlerMeasure_le_sum_norm_coeff _).trans ?_
  rw [Polynomial.sum_def]
  have hsupp : ((zq2 s).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).support ⊆ Finset.range 3 := by
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.mem_range]
    have h1 := Polynomial.le_natDegree_of_mem_supp n hn
    rw [natDegree_map_zq2] at h1
    omega
  refine (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsupp
    (fun i _ _ => norm_nonneg _)).trans ?_
  rw [show (3 : ℕ) = 2 + 1 from rfl, Finset.sum_range_succ,
    Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_one]
  rw [coeff_map_zq2 _ 0 (by norm_num), coeff_map_zq2 _ 1 (by norm_num),
    coeff_map_zq2 _ 2 (by norm_num)]
  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := s
  simp only [tupCoeff2, tupL1_2, Complex.norm_intCast]
  push_cast
  rw [abs_one]
  linarith [abs_nonneg (a : ℝ), abs_nonneg (b : ℝ)]

name: PDT.Mahler.upper_cert2_sound
proof:
:= by
  set M : ℝ := ((zq2 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure with hM
  have hQ0 : (0 : ℝ) < (Q : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K) := by positivity
  have hl1 := mahlerMeasure_map_zq2_le_l1 (gr2Z^[K] t)
  rw [mahlerMeasure_map_gr2Z_iterate, ← hM] at hl1
  have hR : (tupL1_2 (gr2Z^[K] t) : ℝ) * (Q : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K)
      ≤ (P : ℝ) ^ (2 ^ K) := by exact_mod_cast h
  have hpow : M ^ (2 ^ K) ≤ ((P : ℝ) / Q) ^ (2 ^ K) := by
    rw [div_pow, le_div_iff₀ hQ0]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hl1 (le_of_lt hQ0)).trans hR
  exact le_of_pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (by positivity) hpow

name: PDT.Mahler.lowerHit2_sound
proof:
:= by
  unfold lowerHit2 at h
  simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
  rcases h with h | h
  · have hc : ((Nat.choose 2 0 : ℕ) : ℤ) = 1 := by norm_num
    exact lower_cert2_sound (K := K) (k := 0) hQ (by norm_num)
      (by rw [hc]; exact h)
  · have hc : ((Nat.choose 2 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = 2 := by norm_num
    exact lower_cert2_sound (K := K) (k := 1) hQ (by norm_num)
      (by rw [hc]; exact h)

name: PDT.Mahler.lowerCert2_sound
statement:
lemma lowerCert2_sound {P Q : ℕ} (hQ : 0 < Q) :
    ∀ (fuel K : ℕ) (t : Z2),
      lowerCert2 fuel ((P : ℤ) ^ 2 ^ K) ((Q : ℤ) ^ 2 ^ K) (gr2Z^[K] t) = true →
      (P : ℝ) / Q < ((zq2 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
proof:
:= by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero => intro K t h; simp [lowerCert2] at h
  | succ fuel ih =>
      intro K t h
      unfold lowerCert2 at h
      simp only [Bool.or_eq_true] at h
      rcases h with h1 | h2
      · exact lowerHit2_sound hQ h1
      · have e1 : ((P : ℤ) ^ 2 ^ K) ^ 2 = (P : ℤ) ^ 2 ^ (K + 1) := by
          rw [← pow_mul, pow_succ]
        have e2 : ((Q : ℤ) ^ 2 ^ K) ^ 2 = (Q : ℤ) ^ 2 ^ (K + 1) := by
          rw [← pow_mul, pow_succ]
        have e3 : gr2Z (gr2Z^[K] t) = gr2Z^[K + 1] t :=
          (Function.iterate_succ_apply' gr2Z K t).symm
        rw [e1, e2, e3] at h2
        exact ih (K + 1) t h2

name: PDT.Mahler.lowerCert2_81_sound
statement:
lemma lowerCert2_81_sound {t : Z2} (h : lowerCert2 9 81 50 t = true) :
    (81 : ℝ) / 50 < ((zq2 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
proof:
:= by
  have hs := lowerCert2_sound (P := 81) (Q := 50) (by norm_num) 9 0 t
  simp only [pow_zero, pow_one, Function.iterate_zero_apply] at hs
  have h' : lowerCert2 9 ((81 : ℕ) : ℤ) ((50 : ℕ) : ℤ) t = true := by
    exact_mod_cast h
  exact_mod_cast hs h'

name: PDT.Mahler.coeff_zq2
statement:

name: PDT.Mahler.eq_zq2_self
statement:
lemma eq_zq2_self (p : ℤ[X]) (hm : p.Monic) (hd : p.natDegree = 2) :
    p = zq2 (p.coeff 1, p.coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  by_cases hn : n ≤ 2
  · interval_cases n
    · rw [coeff_zq2 _ 0 (by norm_num)]; rfl
    · rw [coeff_zq2 _ 1 (by norm_num)]; rfl
    · rw [coeff_zq2 _ 2 (by norm_num)]
      show p.coeff 2 = 1
      have := hm.coeff_natDegree
      rwa [hd] at this
  · push_neg at hn
    rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by rw [hd]; omega),
      coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by rw [zq2_natDegree_int]; omega)]

name: PDT.Mahler.not_irr_mul11

proof:
:= by
  rw [zq2_mul11]
  intro hi
  rcases hi.isUnit_or_isUnit rfl with h | h
  · exact Polynomial.not_isUnit_of_natDegree_pos _
      (by rw [zlin_natDegree]; norm_num) h
  · exact Polynomial.not_isUnit_of_natDegree_pos _
      (by rw [zlin_natDegree]; norm_num) h

name: PDT.Mahler.mahler2_eq_one_of_dvd
proof:
:= by
  have hX : ((X : ℤ[X]) ^ n - 1) ≠ 0 := by
    have := X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero hn (1 : ℤ)
    simpa using this
  have hg : g ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [mul_zero] at hfac
    exact hX hfac.symm
  have hmapped := congrArg (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)) hfac
  rw [Polynomial.map_mul] at hmapped
  have hXmap : (((X : ℤ[X]) ^ n - 1).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ))
      = (X : ℂ[X]) ^ n - 1 := by
    simp
  rw [hXmap] at hmapped
  have hM := congrArg Polynomial.mahlerMeasure hmapped
  rw [mahlerMeasure_mul, mahlerMeasure_X_pow_sub_one hn] at hM
  have h1t : 1 ≤ ((zq2 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure :=
    one_le_mahlerMeasure_of_ne_zero (zq2_monic_int t).ne_zero
  have h1g : 1 ≤ (g.map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure :=
    one_le_mahlerMeasure_of_ne_zero hg
  have hle : ((zq2 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure ≤ 1 := by
    calc ((zq2 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
        ≤ ((zq2 t).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure
            * (g.map (Int.castRingHom ℂ)).mahlerMeasure :=
          le_mul_of_one_le_right (le_trans zero_le_one h1t) h1g
      _ = 1 := hM
  exact le_antisymm hle h1t
