name: PDT.A_noncomm_explicit
statement: theorem A_noncomm_explicit : A₀ * A₁ ≠ A₁ * A₀
proof:
:= by
  intro hcontra
  have h02 := congrArg (fun M : Mat => M 0 2) hcontra
  norm_num [A₀, A₁, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_four, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
    Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.cons_val_three,
    Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons] at h02

name: EuclideanSpace.volume_toSphere_univ
statement:
theorem volume_toSphere_univ :
    (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)).toSphere Set.univ
      = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.sqrt π ^ card ι / Real.Gamma (card ι / 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hcpos : 0 < (card ι : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hc2 : (card ι : ℝ) / 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hg : Real.Gamma ((card ι : ℝ) / 2) ≠ 0 := (Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos (by positivity)).ne'
  rw [Measure.toSphere_apply_univ, finrank_euclideanSpace, EuclideanSpace.volume_ball,
    ENNReal.ofReal_one, one_pow, one_mul, ← ENNReal.ofReal_natCast,
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
  congr 1
  rw [Real.Gamma_add_one hc2]
  field_simp

name: EuclideanSpace.volume_toSphere_univ_fin_four
statement:
theorem volume_toSphere_univ_fin_four :
    (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 4))).toSphere Set.univ
      = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * π ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : Real.sqrt π ^ 4 = π ^ 2 := by
    rw [show (4 : ℕ) = 2 * 2 from rfl, pow_mul, Real.sq_sqrt Real.pi_pos.le]
  rw [volume_toSphere_univ, Fintype.card_fin, hsq, show ((4 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 = 2 by norm_num,
    Real.Gamma_two, div_one]

name: PDT.sqrt_two_cubed_eq
statement: theorem sqrt_two_cubed_eq : (Real.sqrt 2) ^ 3 = 2 * Real.sqrt 2
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  calc (Real.sqrt 2) ^ 3 = (Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2 * Real.sqrt 2 := by ring
    _ = 2 * Real.sqrt 2 := by rw [h]

name: PDT.tsirelson_const_lt_three
statement: theorem tsirelson_const_lt_three : (Real.sqrt 2) ^ 3 < 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [sqrt_two_cubed_eq]
  have h : Real.sqrt 2 < 3 / 2 := by
    rw [show (3:ℝ)/2 = Real.sqrt ((3/2)^2) by rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)]]
    apply Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (by norm_num)
    norm_num
  nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 2, Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)]

name: PDT.chsh_le_two_sqrt_two
statement:
theorem chsh_le_two_sqrt_two
    {R : Type*} [Ring R] [PartialOrder R] [StarRing R] [StarOrderedRing R]
    [Algebra ℝ R] [IsOrderedModule ℝ R] [StarModule ℝ R]
    (A₀ A₁ B₀ B₁ : R) (T : IsCHSHTuple A₀ A₁ B₀ B₁) :
    A₀ * B₀ + A₀ * B₁ + A₁ * B₀ - A₁ * B₁ ≤ (2 * Real.sqrt 2) • (1 : R)
proof:
:= by
  have h := tsirelson_inequality A₀ A₁ B₀ B₁ T
  rwa [sqrt_two_cubed_eq] at h

name: PDT.s_sq
statement: theorem s_sq : s * s = (1 : ℝ) / 2
proof:

  norm_num

name: PDT.isCHSH
statement:
theorem isCHSH : IsCHSHTuple A₀ A₁ B₀ B₁ where
  A₀_inv
proof:
:= by rw [sq]; exact A₀_sq
  A₁_inv := by rw [sq]; exact A₁_sq
  B₀_inv := by
    rw [sq, B₀, smul_mul_smul_comm, B₀i_sq, smul_smul, s_sq]
    norm_num
  B₁_inv := by
    rw [sq, B₁, smul_mul_smul_comm, B₁i_sq, smul_smul, s_sq]
    norm_num
  A₀_sa := A₀_sa
  A₁_sa := A₁_sa
  B₀_sa := by rw [B₀, star_smul, B₀i_sa, star_trivial]
  B₁_sa := by rw [B₁, star_smul, B₁i_sa, star_trivial]
  A₀B₀_commutes := by rw [B₀, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, A₀B₀i_comm]
  A₀B₁_commutes := by rw [B₁, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, A₀B₁i_comm]
  A₁B₀_commutes := by rw [B₀, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, A₁B₀i_comm]
  A₁B₁_commutes := by rw [B₁, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, A₁B₁i_comm]

proof:

  ext i; fin_cases i <;>
    simp [vsat, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_four] <;> ring

name: PDT.chsh_saturates
statement:
theorem chsh_saturates :
    (A₀ * B₀ + A₀ * B₁ + A₁ * B₀ - A₁ * B₁).mulVec vsat
      = (2 * Real.sqrt 2) • vsat
proof:
:= by
  
  have hop : A₀ * B₀ + A₀ * B₁ + A₁ * B₀ - A₁ * B₁ = s • Mchsh := by
    unfold Mchsh B₀ B₁
    rw [mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm, mul_smul_comm]
    rw [smul_sub, smul_add, smul_add]
  rw [hop]
  
  rw [Matrix.smul_mulVec, Mchsh_mulVec, smul_smul]
  
  have hcoef : (4 : ℝ) * s = 2 * Real.sqrt 2 := by
    have h2 : Real.sqrt 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    unfold s
    field_simp
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2)]
    ring
  rw [show s * (4:ℝ) = (4:ℝ) * s by ring, hcoef]

name: PDT.vsat_ne_zero

proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have : vsat 0 = (0 : Fin 4 → ℝ) 0 := by rw [h]
  simp [vsat] at this
